Who we are
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet.
Stripe Apps connect Stripe with the tools businesses already use, bringing relevant data and workflows into the Stripe Dashboard and third-party systems. The Strategic Apps team owns a portfolio of integrations with enterprise systems that are critical to our users’ workflows—from quote-to-cash and support to reporting. We help users embed Stripe more deeply into the way they run their businesses.

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to set the strategy and lead execution for Strategic Apps. You will own a portfolio of existing and new integrations, including those with systems such as Salesforce, and determine where Stripe should invest based on user needs, Stripe’s product and industry priorities, and market signals. You will work across Stripe and directly with external partners to deliver reliable, high-quality integrations that drive adoption and business outcomes.
Own the vision, product strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for a portfolio of strategic apps, making and communicating clear trade-offs amid significant ambiguity.
Identify, prioritize, and validate the highest-value user problems and integration opportunities through direct user research, ecosystem analysis, and quantitative evidence.
Lead cross-functional teams across Engineering, Design, Data Science, Finance, Sales, User Support, Marketing, Partner Management, and other product teams to deliver and evolve integrations end to end.
Partner with Engineering to define product requirements, technical approach, and quality standards for integrations, including APIs, documentation, edge cases, reliability, security, compliance, and ongoing maintenance.
Establish feedback loops and measurement plans before launch; use product, business, and user metrics to assess efficacy, diagnose changes in performance, and continuously improve adoption, retention, and revenue outcomes.
Represent Stripe’s product strategy with strategic technology partners and enterprise users, building productive relationships with product and technical counterparts and incorporating their feedback into roadmap decisions.
Drive launches, beta programs, user acceptance testing, and go-to-market readiness in partnership with Marketing, Sales, Partner Management, and Support; ensure teams have the materials and operating model needed to support adoption at scale.
Make and drive important cross-functional decisions, align senior stakeholders around a shared strategy, and communicate progress, risks, and outcomes clearly.
Balance new feature development with investment in quality, reliability, technical debt, and foundational platform capabilities across the app portfolio.
Improve how Stripe builds and operates strategic integrations by turning user, partner, and performance signals into scalable product and process improvements.

8+ years of relevant product-management, engineering, or equivalent experience, including ownership of a high-quality product or feature area at scale or a major evolution of an existing product.
Experience setting product strategy and driving execution across multiple cross-functional teams or a complex product area, from ambiguous problem definition through launch and iteration.
Demonstrated ability to use qualitative and quantitative evidence to define success metrics, evaluate product performance, and make prioritization decisions.
Strong technical judgment and fluency working with engineers on API-based products, integrations, technical constraints, and product quality.
Experience engaging directly with enterprise users and external technology partners, and translating their needs into clear product decisions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and leading through organizational boundaries.

Experience with enterprise business systems and workflows, such as CRM, ERP, quote-to-cash, support, or reporting platforms; familiarity with Salesforce, Oracle, SAP, or Microsoft Dynamics is a plus.
Experience building or scaling platform, ecosystem, marketplace, or partner-integrated products.
Experience growing product adoption, usage, or revenue through product-led and go-to-market initiatives.
Experience in payments, financial technology, or other regulated technology environments.
A degree in computer science, engineering, or another technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Stripe · Professional Services · Global Transformation team · Dublin or London
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Stripe's Professional Services (ProServ) team helps businesses around the world design, implement, and optimise their Stripe integrations. As we scale our global delivery capability, we are building a structured portfolio of service offerings that define the scope, methodology, resourcing, and commercial terms of how we engage with our users.

We are looking for a Product Manager ( Professional Services) to own the portfolio of offerings end-to-end. The role sits at the intersection of services strategy, commercial design, and delivery operations. You will be the person who determines whether our offerings are well-designed, effectively sold, and profitably delivered and you will take action to refine the portfolio as needed.
This is not a traditional Product Manager role, but it demands the same rigour. Your "product" is the service itself: its scope, its pricing, its methodology, and its performance. You will work closely with Sales, Delivery, Finance, and Stripe's Product organisation to ensure that every offering in our portfolio is fit for purpose and continuously improving.

Own the offering portfolio for Professional Services
Maintain and govern ProServ’s offering portfolio including scope, hours, pricing, and resource plans for each offering. Our portfolio includes offerings designed for all user segments from start-ups to enterprises
Manage the full offering lifecycle: design, build, launch, iterate, and deprecate offerings based on market need, delivery performance, and product roadmap changes
Ensure the portfolio stays current as Stripe launches new products
Design and implement a governance framework for the portfolio of offerings
Drive offering performance analytics
Define and track the offering KPIs: attach rate, average scope deviation, planned vs. actual burn rate, gross margin per offering, and customer satisfaction
Run regular performance reviews and present findings to ProServ leadership with clear recommendations
Refine and Improve Offering Design
Analyse delivery burn data to identify offerings that are systematically over- or under-scoped, and propose refinements
Conduct structured retrospectives with Delivery Leads after engagement close to capture insights and feedback
Serve as the structured feedback loop between Delivery (what is hard to deliver), Sales (what is hard to sell), and Finance (what is margin-accretive), synthesising those inputs into offering design decisions

Required
7+ years of Professional Services or consulting delivery experience
Demonstrable experience shaping or owning a service offering
Commercial literacy
Strong analytical skills
Excellent written communication
Product Management training or experience
The ability to apply product thinking (hypothesis, prototype, measure, iterate) to service design

Familiarity with Certinia and/or Salesforce
Exposure to partner and SI ecosystem dynamics

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies.

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request.

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up.

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations: Austin or San Francisco (Hybrid)

For 30 years, the web has run on a simple economic bargain: trading content for human attention. That attention has been monetized through advertising, subscriptions, and e-commerce. This bargain funded the Internet as we know it.
But as agents become the dominant Internet users, the model is breaking. An agent does not look at ads or need to maintain a monthly subscription to all the tools it wants to access. It reads a page or consumes a data feed once, takes what it needs, and moves on. Across the web, AI crawlers already request content anywhere from a hundred to tens of thousands of times for every visitor they send back . We need new business models, fit for this new era.
Cloudflare has spent years detecting bots, allowing domain owners to take control of whether bots can access them. What's been missing is the other half: how agents interact with those sites once they're let in. That's what our team, the Agentic Internet team is focused on: making the web readable, discoverable, callable, and payable .

These four primitives are all built on open standards, so no single company owns the rails. Cloudflare believes in the open Internet, and we're in a position to help build the future where it thrives. Come help us make it happen!
You can read more about some of our big bets here and here .

Shape the product strategy for new Internet-scale business models
Deliver product specifications, prototypes, product positioning, and high-impact launches
Partner with Engineering, Design, Research, and GTM to ship at high velocity
Work with Partnerships and BD to define the new business models for the open web
Represent the product externally with users, customers, AI labs, developers, and more

5+ years as a technical PM; developer-facing experience and AI/ML preferred
A builder: you get things done, can move quickly, and prefer ‘show’ over ‘tell’
A strong communicator who is comfortable with ambiguity
Technically literate — you don't need to write Rust, but you should be able to push back on a tech lead on the merits of a particular direction
Payments, FinTech, or blockchain experience is a plus
Team oriented - You’d rather get it right than be right
How we work
At Cloudflare, performance is about outcomes (what you did) and behaviors (how you did it). We value curiosity, humility, empathy, and doing the principled thing. Learn more about our values on our Careers page .
Why this role
You’re joining a fast-moving team, breaking new ground. Read more about some of our big bets here and here .

What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .
Pinterest is uniquely positioned across the full consumer journey—from inspiration and discovery through consideration, planning, and action. Creators bring ideas to life, Pinners signal emerging interests and intent, and advertisers help people act on what inspires them.

This role will define how Pinterest measures that flywheel, helping advertisers understand how Pinterest and its creators build awareness and drive business outcomes, while helping creators understand the value they generate and unlock new opportunities with brands.
The ideal candidate is a Staff-level product leader with substantial ads measurement experience and a deep understanding of how advertisers set objectives, deploy tactics across the full funnel, and evaluate outcomes. They have worked cross-functionally with engineering, data science, research, PMM, sales, and other partners and can translate complex measurement methods into credible, useful, and scalable products.

Own the strategy and end-to-end execution for demonstrating the full-funnel value of Pinterest, including the creator–Pinner–advertiser flywheel. Define the vision for new and existing measurement capabilities and translate advertiser and creator needs into clear product and technical requirements.

Create and deliver a multi-quarter roadmap, aligning data foundations, measurement methodologies, experimentation, privacy guardrails, and customer-facing experiences to drive measurable creator, advertiser, and Pinner outcomes.
Partner day-to-day with engineering, data science/analytics, design, and research to deliver high-quality products; collaborate with PMM, sales, partnerships, legal, privacy, and policy/integrity for launches. Work closely with PM peers across Ads, Creators, Content, and Shopping to manage dependencies, align measurement frameworks and experiment design, coordinate GTM, and incorporate customer feedback.
Build new and iterate on measurement products that help advertisers understand how creator content, organic engagement, and paid media contribute across awareness, consideration, intent, conversion, and longer-term value. Enable creators to understand the value they generate for brands and identify new business opportunities. Define success metrics and validation standards up front, track adoption and quality post-launch, and use insights to update the roadmap.

8+ years of experience working as a Product Manager or in a related role, including 3–5+ years of substantial ads or marketing measurement experience.
Strong evidence of the ability to define new products and strategies in an ambiguous space and execute from ideation and multi-quarter roadmaps through go-to-market and adoption.
Deep understanding of the full marketing funnel and how advertisers set objectives, deploy tactics, and evaluate outcomes.
Experience working with engineering, data science, analytics, research, or PMM cross-functional teams and a strong ability to empathize with, anticipate the needs of, and collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders.
Strong quantitative judgment and understanding of attribution, incrementality, experimentation, brand lift, conversion lift, and measurement tradeoffs.
Deep understanding of business metrics and tradeoffs in the context of online platforms or multi-sided ecosystems.
Preferred but not required: Experience with creator, influencer, branded-content, social, video, commerce, or organic-and-paid measurement.
Preferred but not required: Experience building advertiser-facing measurement products or working with advertisers, agencies, creators, marketing science teams, or measurement partners.
Preferred but not required: Technical degree in CS/Statistics/Math/Engineering/Economics.
Preferred but not required: Experience designing, running, or analyzing incrementality or lift experiments.

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

Reddit's developer ecosystem is one of the biggest opportunities to make Reddit more useful, expressive, extensible, and valuable. Today, most people who build on Reddit are developers: they write code, use Devvit, work with APIs, and ship apps or games through a relatively technical workflow. That ecosystem is growing quickly and remains critical.
But the future is bigger than developers alone. AI-assisted building is changing who can create software. The next generation of Reddit apps, games, tools, community agents, content formats, and workflows should be buildable by many more people: developers, technically curious creators, moderators, community builders, game designers, data partners, and eventually people who can describe what they want without needing to code it by hand.
The Developer Ecosystem team owns the product systems that help this broader set of builders discover opportunities, create successfully, launch high-quality apps and games, reach the right users and communities, adopt new platform capabilities, and keep improving after launch.

This includes surfaces and systems like developers.reddit.com, AI-assisted creation, app review, developer and creator onboarding, app marketplace experiences, platform capabilities, best practices, and support for emerging creator categories.

We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead Reddit's Builder Ecosystem product strategy. This person will define the roadmap for how Reddit moves from a developer-only ecosystem to a broader builder ecosystem where AI-assisted and no-code creation become first-class parts of the platform.
The role spans developer growth, creator onboarding, AI-assisted building, app quality, ecosystem incentives, platform capabilities, app marketplace strategy, operational tooling, feature adoption, and new builder categories.
This is a high-ambiguity platform role with direct business, product, and community impact. The right PM will be able to bridge two worlds: they should understand the needs of serious developers and platform engineers, while also having strong conviction that Reddit can unlock a much larger wave of builders by making creation more accessible, guided, AI-native, and outcome-oriented.

Define the product strategy for Reddit's Developer Ecosystem, including the transition from code-first developers to a broader base of AI-assisted creators.
Own the roadmap for developers.reddit.com as the primary builder portal, including onboarding, docs, app management, analytics, review status, feature access, education, examples, templates, and AI-assisted creation entry points.
Lead strategy for AI-assisted app creation, including prompt-to-app workflows, AI building tools, no-code or low-code experiences, reusable templates, generated scaffolds, and systems that help creators turn ideas into useful Reddit-native apps.
Build the product approach for an App Marketplace that helps users, moderators, communities, and internal teams discover high-quality apps, games, agents, tools, and community experiences.
Improve app review and ecosystem operations through tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows, including LLM-powered app review, policy checks, quality signals, and reviewer efficiency.
Partner with Engineering to prioritize core platform capabilities and performance improvements such as webhooks, webviews, APIs, SDKs, tooling, observability, and other primitives builders need to create reliable apps.
Drive more successful, retentive, and popular apps and games by identifying best practices, improving templates, shaping incentives, and creating clearer paths from idea to launch to growth.
Identify and support new creator and developer categories
Partner with internal teams such as Contribution, Community Builders, Games, Search, Recommendations, Safety, and Ads to help them launch new functionality through the developer ecosystem.
Define and improve feature adoption programs so builders understand, test, and successfully use new platform capabilities.
Work with developer relations to establish the measurement system for the ecosystem, including weekly active developers/creators, NPS/CSAT, app launches, app retention and more
Create clear frameworks for when Reddit should build platform primitives, launch templates, fund builders, partner with external teams, promote apps, or shut down low-quality or low-trust ecosystem behavior.
Lead cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, DevRel, Community, Data, Safety, Legal, Policy, Support, BD, and senior leadership.

Experience leading high-ambiguity platform, developer ecosystem, creator ecosystem, marketplace, gaming, AI tooling, or developer experience products.
Strong product judgment for creation platforms: understanding what makes a platform powerful for advanced developers, approachable for new creators, trustworthy for communities, and worth sustained investment.
Comfort with code, APIs, developer tools, technical platform tradeoffs, and engineering conversations, paired with strong conviction that AI-assisted and no-code creation will expand who can build on Reddit.
Ability to reason across multiple sides of the ecosystem: developers, creators, users, moderators, communities, internal teams, partners, and Reddit's business priorities.
Experience improving developer or creator onboarding, docs, portals, SDKs, APIs, marketplaces, app review, app distribution, AI creation tools, or app-building workflows.
Strong analytical judgment and comfort defining metrics for ecosystem health, builder productivity, app quality, retention, distribution, and business impact.
Ability to partner deeply with Engineering on platform capabilities, performance, reliability, primitives, observability, and build-vs-buy decisions.
Strong product sense for apps, games, agents, content creation tools, community-native experiences, and the kinds of lightweight software that should exist inside Reddit communities.
Comfort working with AI-assisted creation tools, LLM-based workflows, prompt-to-app systems, or other emerging ways of helping more people build software.
Excellent written communication and decision frameworks that help teams make crisp investment decisions in ambiguous spaces.

At Sierra, we’re building a platform to enable every company in the world to build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We partner with industry leaders such as SoftBank, Uber, Rivian, CLEAR, and Sutter Health. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.
We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.
Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor . Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps.

Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.
About the Public Sector team
Sierra recently received FedRAMP High certification, enabling us to bring our industry-leading technology to partners in the US public sector. We’re now building our founding public sector team to redefine the relationship between the government and its citizenry.
Today, our agents already enable citizens to access social services, report fraud, and understand complex government systems. Simultaneously, they empower government officials to better hear the concerns and inquiries of their constituencies.
We are explicitly nonpartisan and committed to empowering public servants to leverage AI to advance their important missions.
In our journey, we are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Build enterprise-grade AI agents for government institutions: As an Agent Product Manager at Sierra, you will partner directly with our engineers and public sector customers to build and ship AI agents that serve people across high-stakes, mission-critical interactions. These agents will help constituents navigate complex programs, complete important tasks, and get timely, trustworthy support while meeting the security, accessibility, and reliability standards government work demands.
Discover where agents can make the greatest impact: Ground-up discovery is a critical part of the role. Work closely with federal and state institutions to understand their missions, operating constraints, constituent needs, and service-delivery workflows. Identify and prioritize new opportunities for AI agents to improve access, responsiveness, and outcomes.
Engage with customers at every level: Become a trusted advisor to public sector leaders and a hands-on partner to their working teams. Discover and assess requirements, prepare and present demonstrations, navigate technical and operational challenges with customer counterparts, and continuously improve agents to fit each institution’s policies and workflows.
Own outcomes from concept through production: Translate mission goals into a clear product strategy, roadmap, and measurable definition of success. Coordinate across customer stakeholders, engineering, design, research, security, and operations to take agents from initial concept through launch and ongoing iteration.
Shape the platform and public sector roadmap: Your direct work with government institutions will guide the evolution of Sierra’s core platform. Surface unmet needs, prototype new tools and features, and collaborate with research, product, and platform teams to shape the future of AI agent development for the public sector.
Help build Sierra’s public sector business: Partner closely with public sector leadership on market strategy, product investments, and repeatable approaches that allow the team to scale quickly while preserving the trust and craftsmanship our customers expect.
Example projects
These are examples of projects our healthcare team has worked on:
Build agents that help people understand eligibility, apply for benefits, check case status, and navigate complex social-service programs.
Develop secure reporting experiences that make it easier to report fraud, waste, abuse, or other concerns and route each submission appropriately.
Create voice and chat agents that answer questions about licenses, permits, taxes, public records, and other high-volume government services across languages and channels.
Design proactive and long-horizon agents that keep constituents informed, collect missing information, and guide them through multi-step government processes over time.
Turn patterns in constituent conversations into actionable insights that help public officials understand emerging needs and improve service delivery.

5-7+ years of experience developing highly technical products.
Experience in Product Management or a similar product development role at or above the level of Senior Product Manager.
A passion for public sector work and a belief in the potential of our institutions to transform outcomes for the people they serve.
Comfort working directly with customers to understand their needs, navigate complex organizations, and solve real-world problems. A core part of the role is coordinating directly with public servants and technical stakeholders to understand their workflows.
Experience crafting and tailoring messages for different audiences, including senior executives and public sector leaders.
Ability to communicate highly technical concepts to both non-technical and technically proficient audiences, including recent developments in AI.
Strong product judgment and a track record of driving ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives from discovery through launch and measurable impact.
A degree in a technical or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Even better...
Experience building or deploying AI/LLM products, especially conversational or long-horizon agents, and familiarity with evaluation, retrieval, prompt engineering, or agent tooling.
Experience with government technology or working with public sector institutions, including an understanding of procurement, regulation, security, accessibility, and patterns of partnership.
A demonstrated track record of operating in ambiguity, for example as part of a founding team, a new initiative within a large organization, or a forward-deployed product or engineering team.
Some coding experience with React, TypeScript, and Go, or experience prototyping technical products directly with engineers.
An MBA or equivalent professional experience at the intersection of technology, operations, and strategy.
Past roles that involved working directly with end customers to influence software development.

Know where you belong!

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.

HER is the world’s largest community for lesbian, bisexual, and queer people. We’re a global, subscription-based consumer product serving millions of LGBTQIA+ users across 55+ countries — helping people connect, date, and build community in ways that feel authentic, affirming, and fun.
HER is part of Match Group, the global leader in dating products, and sits within Match Group’s Everyone & Everywhere (E&E) portfolio alongside other identity-led platforms. This gives us the best of both worlds: the scale, insight, and infrastructure of a global organization, with the autonomy, speed, and cultural focus of a small, mission-driven team.
We're hiring a Product Manager I to own product execution at HER on a 9-month temporary basis. You'll run the day-to-day product/engineering sprint cadence — standups, planning, backlog grooming, unblocking — while also shaping what's on the roadmap: pitching ideas and weighing in on feature and design discussions. This is not a pure execution role. On a small, senior team, you'll have real ownership and a direct line to the people building HER's brand and product vision.

Sprint & Execution Ownership
Run the product/engineering sprint cadence — standups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retros
Keep releases on track and unblock engineering as issues arise
Translate roadmap priorities into clear, well-scoped tickets and specs
Roadmap & Ideation
Contribute original ideas to the roadmap — this role is expected to pitch, not just deliver
Weigh in on feature scoping and design discussions alongside Design, Data/Analytics, and Engineering
Use data and qualitative insight to prioritize what gets built next
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with Design, Data/Analytics, Engineering, and CRM to ship high-quality experiences
Coordinate periodically (roughly every other week) with the broader Emerging & Evergreen product team
Build relationships with HER's Head of Product and founder to stay aligned with brand vision
Data-Informed Decision-Making
Use product analytics to inform prioritization and measure the impact of shipped work
Design and interpret experiments in partnership with Data/Analytics

s.h: We could be a Match if
s.t:

This is an inbound technical product manager role. You'll own the design and delivery of ServiceNow's ITSM and ITOM products — Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, Service Catalog, Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and CMDB — in a live production environment, measure how they actually perform, and use that evidence to influence what the products should become.
Three things make this role distinct from a standard implementation specialist:
You own the outcome, not the deployment. Go-live is the midpoint. You instrument the solution, track adoption and performance in production, and iterate when the data says the design didn't land.
You're the voice of the customer, from inside. You'll partner directly with ServiceNow Product Management for ITSM and ITOM — evaluating new and pre-GA capability under real operational load, documenting gaps with evidence, and tracking them to closure.
You can carry the story upward. You'll represent this work in executive forums, translating implementation detail into the impact language leadership needs to make decisions.
You'll spend part of your week across the table from business stakeholders shaping requirements, part with engineering getting it built, and part with Product shaping the roadmap. If you only want one of those three, this isn't the role.

Shape the solution
Run discovery sessions with business stakeholders and process owners to understand current-state pain, process gaps, and desired outcomes
Translate business requirements into a recommended ServiceNow solution design, and pitch it credibly — including where out-of-box beats customization and where scope should be cut
Drive alignment across competing stakeholders, secure sign-off on scope and design decisions, and document the agreed solution
Deliver it with engineering
Translate approved designs into deployable epics and stories with clear acceptance criteria, dependencies, and definition of done — well-formed enough that engineering can build without guessing
Walk engineering through design intent, defend the "why" behind decisions, and work through technical trade-offs and constraints collaboratively as build progresses
Act as the single point of translation between engineering and the business. When engineering needs clarification, you go get it — you own the round trip back to the business stakeholder rather than pulling engineers into stakeholder meetings to ask directly
Manage scope, sequencing, and backlog priority with engineering through the build, and unblock decisions rather than escalating them
Own UAT coordination, go-live readiness, and hypercare
Advise on platform best practices, upgrade-safe design, and technical debt avoidance
Measure it
Instrument every implementation for measurability from day one — define success metrics and baselines before build starts, not after go-live
Personally build and maintain the reports and dashboards that show whether the solution is actually delivering: adoption, deflection, cycle time, process compliance, data quality, and where the process is leaking
Use the data to drive iteration — surface underperformance to stakeholders proactively, recommend fixes, and close the loop rather than declaring victory at deployment
Accelerate it
Use AI tooling to compress delivery cycles — apply general-purpose AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to accelerate requirements synthesis, data analysis, rapid prototyping of solution concepts for stakeholder validation, test case generation, and documentation — and bring a point of view on where AI genuinely speeds delivery versus where it adds noise
Influence the product
Represent your work in executive forums like monthly product reviews: what you delivered, why that approach, and what measurable impact it created. Distill technical detail into outcome language a VP can act on
Partner with ServiceNow Product Management for ITSM and ITOM — build durable working relationships with the teams building these products, evaluate new and pre-GA capabilities in a real production environment, and provide grounded, constructive feedback based on actual adoption experience
Own the product gap loop — document capability gaps that block or slow adoption, translate them into clear, evidence-backed asks with business impact attached, and track them through to closure with Product and Engineering rather than logging them and moving on

As Senior Lead – Apparel Materials Development Performance, you will take responsibility for executing the global performance materials strategy and advancing textile technology in line with the company vision. The role includes overseeing fabric creation, advanced material development, and technical execution, as well as collaborating across functions to support performance, sustainability, and high-performance product objectives.
You will manage material development projects across multiple seasons, support the execution of the global materials strategy, and work closely with Design, Development, Product Management, and Sustainability teams. You will also mentor junior specialists depending on project scope, and guide cross-functional partners to deliver innovative material solutions from concept through to garment production.

-Strategic Sourcing & Creation: Define, develop, and lead the creation and strategic sourcing of technical, high-performance apparel materials (including knits, wovens, and applicable trims or embellishment) in accordance with design briefs, product roadmaps, timelines, sourcing policies, and sustainability requirements.
· Standards & Quality Control: Establish and manage fabric availability standards, sourcing policies, and quality assurance processes, supporting target prices and adherence to program timelines across the global supply chain.
-Multi-Season Management: Lead material development workstreams within assigned projects, coordinating across multiple apparel product seasons to ensure alignment with program objectives.
· Sustainability Leadership: Drive and report on material-specific targets in line with the company sustainability roadmap, ensuring compliance, circularity, and supporting continuous improvement in raw materials.
Technical Specifications: Create and maintain material and trim specifications, print applications, and related documentation using PLM system, supporting the adoption of best practices within the team.
· Lifecycle & Testing: Manage the material lifecycle, ensuring all textiles and substrates are robustly tested for high-intensity sports applications, approved, and continuously improved, leveraging expertise in yarns, fabric structures, dyeing, finishing, & printing..
· Supplier Partnerships: Build and maintain strategic relationships with T2 material suppliers (textile mills, print vendors) and T1 factory teams (garment manufacturers) to support material development, quality, and process improvements.
· Library Innovation: Contribute to the development and maintenance of the digital and physical apparel material library and tools used across the product creation team, supporting both inline commercial lines and special innovation projects.
· Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams — Design, Product Development, Product Management, Innovation, Sustainability, and Testing — across global regions (Eu & Asia Sourcing office) to ensure seamless alignment and successful execution of apparel material initiatives.
Your story
· Education: Bachelor’s degree (minimum) in Textile Engineering, Textile Technology, Apparel Science, or a related field; Master’s degree or equivalent experience preferred.
· Experience: 10+ years of experience in performance apparel material/fabric development, with a proven track record in technical textiles, innovative synthetics, or sports apparel execution, including extensive collaboration with Asia-based suppliers and factories.
· Global Mobility: Extensive global travel experience to T2 material mills/suppliers and T1 garment factories to troubleshoot, create, develop, and source materials at the source.
· Project Leadership: Proven experience managing cross-functional material development projects from initial concept to commercial production across a matrixed organization.
· Sport Tech Expertise: Deep affinity for apparel design and technology in the technical performance category, with strong knowledge of performance fabric, garment construction methods (e.g., bonding, seam-sealing, knitting), and industry manufacturing processes.
· Innovation Mindset: Demonstrated success in driving innovation in performance materials (such as moisture management, thermoregulation, and lightweight durability), with experience managing multiple overlapping seasons of product development.
· Analytical & Organized: Strong attention to detail, with the ability to organize complex material data and deliver well-structured presentations and long-term planning documents to leadership.
· Leadership & Mentorship: Deep understanding of apparel industry processes, with the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams and mentoring junior colleagues.
· Communication & Negotiation: Strong collaborative skills and experience engaging with diverse global stakeholders, featuring excellent verbal and written communication and negotiation abilities.
· Agility: Able to balance creative design intent with rigorous technical organization and discipline, thriving in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

The Apparel Materials Development Performance team develops and delivers the company’s performance and sustainability strategy for all apparel textiles and raw materials. The team conducts cutting-edge research, defines global material strategies, and supports projects that advance more sustainable materials, products, and manufacturing processes.
We work closely with cross-functional partners to embed material sustainability and high-performance priorities into the core of garment creation, with a strong focus on effective communication and knowledge sharing. As a Lead, you will contribute your deep technical textile expertise, drive the execution of material strategy, and ensure world-class fabrics and components are successfully integrated across our global sports product lines.

We’re hiring a Principal Product Manager to lead Top of Funnel Lending at Chime. This is a platform role, not a single-product role: it spans every credit product we take top of the funnel for — loans, credit cards, lines of credit, and the products that come next.

You’ll own how members discover, register for, and get approved for credit at Chime, setting acquisition and conversion strategy across the full lending portfolio and building the platform that every current and future lending product grows on top of. The opportunity here is enormous for Chime’s growth.

It is bigger still for the millions of Americans looking for a fair source of liquidity — a little help getting past an unexpected expense, or a way out of bad debt.
As our Principal Product Manager for Lending Top of Funnel, you’ll own the product end-to-end — from defining strategy and prioritizing investments to partnering across Engineering, Design, Data Science, Risk, Operations, Legal, Compliance, Marketing, and Finance to bring your vision to life.

You’ll lead company-program-sized cross-functional efforts: building new registration flows into Chime; growing the funnel with credit bureaus, data rich affiliates, and other channels; partnering with Product Marketing to get sharp on channel optimization and CAC; and building the experiences that determine whether a member converts.

This role reports to the Director of Product.
The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $255,000 and up to $290,000. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.
In this role, you can expect to
Own the strategy and roadmap for lending top of funnel end-to-end, across loans first, but additionally credit cards, lines of credit, and the credit products that come next.
Lead company-program-sized cross-functional efforts, starting with new registration flows into Chime.
Grow the funnel zero to one.
Partner deeply with Product Marketing on channel optimization and CAC to make acquisition efficient at scale.
Build the experiences that decide whether a member converts to Chime for their primary bank.
Give millions of Americans a fair source of liquidity when they need it, whether that’s covering an unexpected expense or getting out of bad debt.
Drive product decisions across the full product lifecycle, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Risk, Operations, Legal, Compliance, Marketing, and Finance.
Make high-conviction prioritization decisions and align cross-functional teams around a clear product vision, measurable outcomes, and business impact.
Use customer insights, experimentation, and data to continuously improve the member experience while growing a profitable business.
Serve as a product leader for the team, creating clarity, setting direction, and ensuring exceptional execution from strategy through launch.
To thrive in this role, you have
11+ years of experience leading consumer product strategy and execution for high-impact digital products from concept through scale.
Direct experience growing the top of funnel for lending products — loans, credit cards, or lines of credit — at a major consumer business, with measurable results on application volume, conversion, and CAC.
A proven track record of owning complex product areas with measurable business outcomes, ideally including growth, monetization, or financial products.
Experience working with credit bureaus, affiliates, and acquisition marketplaces and partnering with Product Marketing on channel strategy.
Experience building or managing complex consumer financial platforms, high-scale fintech products, or mission-critical decisioning systems.
Experience making strategic product decisions in highly cross-functional environments with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Risk, and business partners.
Strong product intuition backed by data, with the ability to prioritize effectively and make thoughtful tradeoffs.
Experience building products that simplify complex customer problems and deliver exceptional user experiences.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and executive audiences.

Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges.

But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved. Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology. QEC is a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion.
Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and government agencies to make fault tolerant quantum computing a reality. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast.

Deltakit is Riverlane’s open-source software development kit (SDK) for QEC which is designed to help researchers build, test and run QEC workflows as the field of quantum computing rapidly evolves.
You’ll sit right at the heart of Deltakit, working closely with users, partners and cross-functional teams to deeply understand real-world challenges and translate them into a compelling product direction. You’ll use a blend of user insight, product data and market context to cut through complexity and focus on what matters most.
You’ll own and evolve Deltakit’s strategy and roadmap, bringing together engineering, research, business development and marketing around a shared vision. You’ll strike the balance between bold, long-term ambition and what’s realistically achievable today, helping us build for the future of quantum computing while delivering value right now.
Beyond the roadmap, you’ll play a key role in bringing Deltakit to life for the community. From supporting launches to engaging directly with users, you’ll shape how we show up, tell our story, and communicate the product’s value in a way that excites and inspires people to build with it.

Engage with users, partners and the open-source community to gather insight and feedback
Analyse product usage, developer behaviour and the broader ecosystem to inform priorities
Define and communicate product vision, strategy and roadmap
Prioritise features and improvements to drive developer adoption and engagement
Align cross-functional teams and guiding product and technical trade-offs
Support launches, user engagement and go-to-market activities
Develop product collateral, and ensuring strong documentation and onboarding experiences
Monitor delivery progress and adapt plans as needed
Drive community engagement and identify opportunities for growth and new use cases

Experience working in a B2B product role, or a closely related position with ownership of product direction and prioritisation
Experience operating in a deep tech environment with complex, evolving problems
A degree in engineering or science, or equivalent practical experience
Confidence going technically deep to understand product capabilities, limitations and real-world usage
The ability to navigate complex trade-offs and shape product strategies that balance user value with feasibility
High emotional intelligence, with strong active listening, critical thinking and creative problem-solving skills
The ability to work cross-functionally, influencing without authority and building trusted relationships
Comfort working in ambiguity and adapting direction in a fast-paced, evolving environment
Excitement for building a product in a new space within technology
Excellent communication, presentation and documentation skills, with the ability to tailor to your style to different audiences
A proactive mindset, able to identify opportunities and take initiative to drive improvements
Even better if you have
Experience working on open-source software products
Experience building software products that interface with hardware products
Experience shipping developer tools (SDKs, libraries, APIs, or CLIs)
Some exposure to quantum computing

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.
Consumers across the globe need safe, transparent financing while merchants want to provide users with their preferred way to pay and convert more buyers. To help achieve this vision, we are hiring a Senior Product Manager for our 1:Many Growth team.
Affirm's Distribution Partnerships program - internally called " 1:Many " - is one of the highest-leverage growth levers at the company. Instead of integrating merchant by merchant, we integrate once into a platform merchants already use, and every merchant on that platform becomes reachable through that single integration. This role is responsible for:
Own and grow Affirm's partner portfolio - making it easier and more frictionless for merchants to onboard and offer Affirm as a payment method to their customers. This includes taking product ownership of Affirm's existing vertical software partnerships, and growing the broader portfolio of platform partners still being stood up.
Partner Acceleration Strategy - building the durable capabilities that make every future partner integration faster to launch and easier to scale, rather than solving the same problem one partner at a time.
As a Senior Product Manager, you will work closely with cross-functional teams including commercial, merchant risk, design, product analytics, and engineering to define, launch and grow integrations with platform partners. Effective stakeholder management and ability to successfully navigate organizational dynamics are a must for success. You should be outcomes-driven with a very high bias for action.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, launch, and grow integrations with payment and platform partners.
Build durable, repeatable capabilities through a Partner Acceleration Strategy that makes future partner integrations faster to launch.
Build relationships with platform partners to gather feedback and insights on product performance, and use it to drive merchant growth.
Define and prioritize product features and requirements to improve the customer, partner, and merchant experience.
Create and manage the product roadmap for the broader 1:Many growth team.
Develop success metrics/OKRs to measure the effectiveness of these initiatives.
Partner with commercial and product marketing teams to develop go-to-market strategies for new partner integrations and features.

5+ years of product management experience
Proven ability to multiple technical software products from kickoff to post-launch, driving meaningful business impact you can clearly articulate.
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration — diving into technical details with engineers, iterating with designers in Figma, and analyzing funnel performance with data analysts.
Strong organizational and communication skills to navigate complex dynamics and drive alignment.
Execution-oriented with a proactive approach to overcoming obstacles and blockers.
Adept at transforming incomplete or conflicting inputs into clear, actionable plans.

About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product Management organization, working with the Delivery Promise team. Du übernimmst die Produktverantwortung für diesen Weg: Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird, in welcher Reihenfolge und warum. Du arbeitest nah an der Entwicklung, am Backlog in GitHub und an Architekturdiskussionen, und du verantwortest die Roadmap gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb, Marketing, Projektgruppe und Support.
In dieser Rolle hast du viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Wenn du die nächsten Jahre lieber ein Produkt von innen prägen willst als ein fertiges zu verwalten - lies weiter!
Deine Aufgaben PRODUKT – Roadmap und Priorisierung
Du verantwortest die DEXIOS-Roadmap und entscheidest laufend, welche Themen jetzt zählen und welche warten
Du priorisierst gegen Nutzen, Aufwand und Marktchance und kannst deine Entscheidungen gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb und Kunden vertreten
Du schneidest Anforderungen so, dass sie umsetzbar sind: User Stories, Akzeptanzkriterien, sinnvolle Releasegrößen
Du pflegst das Backlog in GitHub und arbeitest im Sprint-Rhythmus direkt mit dem Entwicklungsteam
TECHNIK – Architektur und Systemlogik
Du verstehst, wie DEXIOS funktioniert: Mandantenfähigkeit, Rollen- und Rechtemodelle, Berechtigungslogiken, IAM-Anbindung über OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, Konnektoren zu Entra ID, SAP und HR-Systemen
Du diskutierst mit Entwicklung und SW- Architektur auf Augenhöhe über Machbarkeit, Abhängigkeiten und technische Schulden und hast Spaß daran den Prozess proaktiv zu moderieren, um eine Lösung zu finden
Code schreiben gehört nicht dazu - aber die Logik hinter dem System interessiert dich, und du kennst sie gut genug, so dass deine Priorisierung trägt
UX – wie Menschen mit DEXIOS (und zukünftig mit KI) arbeiten
Du hast eine Haltung dazu, wie sich Frontends durch KI verändern: Was bleibt Klickpfad, was wird Dialog, was läuft automatisch im Hintergrund?
Du trägst zur positiven User Experience bei: Wie kommen Sicherheitsverantwortliche, HR-Mitarbeitende oder der Werkschutz mit dem System zurecht, heute und in drei Jahren?
Die Designgrundlagen von DEXIOS stehen. Du arbeitest damit, entwickelst sie weiter und machst die Vorgaben für User Flows bis hin zu Bedienlogiken
KI – in der Rolle und im Produkt
Du nutzt KI in deiner täglichen Arbeit: Prototypen, User Stories, Analysen, Backlog-Aufbereitung, Kundenfeedback verdichten
Du baust Prototypen selbst, statt auf Kapazität zu warten. Ein klickbarer Prototyp in zwei Stunden bringt uns weiter als ein theoretisches Konzept in zwei Wochen
Du bringst deine Perspektive ein, wo KI im Produkt echten Nutzen schafft und wo sie nur Aufsatz wäre
TEAM – Schnittstellen
Du gehst proaktiv auf Kollegen zu, schaffst regelmäßigen Dialog und sorgst dafür, dass Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Entscheidungen für alle Stakeholder nachvollziehbar sind
Du holst Feedback von Kunden sowie aus Support-Anfragen und übersetzt diese in Produktentscheidungen
Du bist bei Kundenterminen dabei, wenn es hilft, und regelmäßig vor Ort in München, weil gute Entscheidungen meist im Gespräch entstehen

The Opportunity
Flosum is looking for a visionary Senior Product Manager who lives and breathes the Salesforce ecosystem and wants to shape the future of how the world's largest enterprises build, secure, and scale on Salesforce.
This is not a maintenance role. You will own the product roadmap for the only 100% Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform trusted by Fortune 100 companies, global brands like Hilton, Cargill, Barry Callebaut, Cushman & Wakefield, and AARP. You will work directly with the CEO and engineering leadership to define and ship products that create entirely new categories within the Salesforce ecosystem.
We are at an inflection point. AI-driven DevOps (powered by Agentforce), agent-aware governance, zero-trust security orchestration, and intelligent data lifecycle management are transforming the Salesforce landscape. We need a product leader who sees around corners, understands where this space is heading, and has the conviction and execution chops to get us there first.
About Flosum
Flosum is the only enterprise-grade DevOps, Data Backup & Archive, Trust Center, and Data Seeding platform built 100% native on the Salesforce platform. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and the only native solution certified by Salesforce, we operate within the Salesforce trust boundary, which means zero data exposure, no third-party cloud processing, and full compliance with Salesforce security standards.
Our customers are among the most demanding in the world: Fortune 500 enterprises in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, government, life sciences) who require SOX compliance, zero-trust architecture, and audit-grade governance. We compete against Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, and Salto, and we win because our native architecture delivers security, speed, and extensibility that external tools simply cannot match.
We recently integrated Salesforce Agentforce into our platform, making Flosum the first and only Salesforce-native AI DevOps solution. This is just the beginning of what we plan to build.
What You Will Own
Product Vision & Strategy
Define and drive the multi-year product roadmap across Flosum 's five product lines: DevOps, Backup & Archive, Trust Center, Data Seeding, and DevOps for Veeva.
Identify whitespace opportunities in the Salesforce ecosystem where Flosum can create new categories or capture market share from competitors.
Translate deep Salesforce platform knowledge (metadata architecture, deployment models, Agentforce, Data Cloud, multi-org environments) into product capabilities that enterprise customers will pay premium prices for.
Stay ahead of Salesforce's own product direction (three releases per year) and position Flosum to capitalize on every platform shift.
AI & Innovation
Lead the next wave of AI-powered DevOps capabilities built on Agentforce, including intelligent deployment agents, AI-driven code review, automated security scanning, and predictive release management.
Define how Flosum 's extensibility platform enables customers to build custom AI-driven workflows within Salesforce's trust boundary.
Pioneer agent-aware governance: preparing Salesforce governance frameworks for autonomous systems and AI agents.
Customer & Market Insight
Engage directly with Fortune 500 customers and prospects to deeply understand their pain points around Salesforce development, security, compliance, and data management.
Translate complex enterprise requirements (SOX, zero-trust, multi-org, regulated industries) into elegant product solutions.
Partner with Sales and Customer Success to influence deal strategy, conduct product demos for strategic accounts, and close competitive evaluations.
Execution & Delivery
Write detailed product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. You do the work, not just delegate it.
Partner with engineering to deliver on aggressive timelines. Own sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and release coordination.
Define and track product KPIs: adoption, activation, expansion, NPS, competitive win rates.

We are looking for a missionary, not a mercenary. Someone who takes genuine ownership of outcomes, thinks independently, and is driven by a need to build something that matters, not just advance their career.
7+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, with at least 3 years focused on the Salesforce ecosystem or Salesforce-adjacent platforms.
Deep technical understanding of the Salesforce platform: metadata-driven architecture, deployment pipelines, sandboxes, packaging, security models, Apex, Lightning, and the ISV partner ecosystem.
Proven track record of shipping products that enterprise customers (Fortune 500, regulated industries) adopted and paid for. Not features; products.
Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, release management, or security/compliance tooling is strongly preferred.
You understand the competitive landscape: Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, Salto, and native Salesforce DX. You know where each is strong and where they are vulnerable.
Strong perspective on how AI/ML (especially Salesforce Agentforce, Einstein, Data Cloud) will reshape the Salesforce development and governance landscape.
Hands-on executor. You write PRDs, you talk to customers, you review wireframes, you sit in sprint reviews. You do not manage from a distance.
Exceptional communication skills. You can present a product vision to a C-suite audience and write a technical specification for an engineering team in the same day.
Intellectual curiosity and a bias toward action. When you see a problem, you solve it. When you don't know something, you go learn it.
What Will Make You Exceptional in This Role
You have experience building products in the Salesforce AppExchange ecosystem, ideally as an ISV or within a Salesforce-native product company.
You have worked at the intersection of DevOps and security/compliance in regulated industries.
You have led product-led growth initiatives within an enterprise product, designing self-serve onboarding, in-product conversion, and expansion mechanics.
You have a point of view on the future of AI in Salesforce DevOps and can articulate a 3-year vision for how autonomous agents will change how enterprises build on Salesforce.
You have experience going head-to-head against well-funded competitors and winning through product superiority rather than just marketing spend.

First 90 Days: Learn and Diagnose
Achieve deep fluency in Flosum 's five product lines and their technical architecture.
Conduct 25+ customer and prospect interviews to build a firsthand understanding of enterprise pain points.
Complete a competitive audit with specific, actionable recommendations on where Flosum should invest to win.

The Opportunity
As Product Manager - Merchant Experience, you will own the discovery, definition, and delivery of Xplor 's self-serve merchant portal: the place where merchants see their transactions and payouts, understand their fees, pull reports, and manage their account.

It is the everyday face of Xplor 's payments platform, and your job is to make it clear, trustworthy, and genuinely useful across global markets. This portal also acts as the internal platform our own teams use to support and configure those merchants.
You will sit at the intersection of product craft, payments, and data - turning information owned by the billing, payout, and financials teams into an experience that answers a merchant's most important questions at a glance: have I been paid, what did it cost me, and is my account set up the way I need? You will partner closely with design and research, and with the upstream teams whose data you surface.

Merchant Portal Strategy & Roadmap
Own and evolve the strategy and roadmap for Xplor 's self-serve merchant portal across global markets.
Define a vision for a merchant experience that is clear, trustworthy, and reduces the need to contact support.
Prioritise ruthlessly against merchant impact, adoption, and support deflection, and present priorities to the VP of Product.
Align your roadmap with the billing, payout, and financials teams whose data the portal surfaces.
Transactions, Payouts & Reporting
Own the surfaces where merchants view transactions and payouts.
Define clear, accurate reporting and statements that merchants can pull themselves, without raising a ticket.
Make fees and deductions transparent, so merchants understand their cost of payments.
Ensure the money shown to merchants is accurate and reconciled with the underlying platform data.
Account Management & Self-Serve
Own merchant self-service: managing account details, users and permissions, and settings without contacting support.
Identify the highest-volume support reasons that the portal should be able to deflect, and design self-serve flows to remove them.
Build in-product help and guidance that meets merchants where they are.
Track and reduce support contact rates for portal-addressable issues as a core metric.
Merchant Configuration & Enablement
Own the configuration portal the BMS team uses to set up and maintain merchants: pricing, fees, product configuration, and account settings.
Own and drive the capabilities of our configuration portal to remove work out of engineering and into the hands of the team closest to the merchant, with the guardrails that money-affecting changes require.
Define validation, approvals, and change history for pricing and fee changes, so a mistake is hard to make and easy to trace.
Work with the billing, payout, and financials teams to make sure configuration set internally is reflected accurately in what the merchant sees and is charged.
Experience, Craft & Adoption
Partner closely with design and engineering to ship intuitive, well-crafted experiences grounded in real merchant needs.
Run discovery with merchants to understand their jobs-to-be-done and validate solutions before building.
Use product analytics to understand behaviour, find friction, and measure the impact of what you ship.
Drive adoption and engagement of the portal, improving task success and merchant satisfaction over time.
AI-Augmented Product Practice
Embed AI tools into every stage of the product lifecycle: use LLMs for rapid synthesis of merchant interviews and support-ticket themes, competitor teardowns, and PRD first drafts; use AI assistants to prototype portal flows and copy without full engineering overhead.
Champion AI adoption across the product team - document effective prompting patterns, share workflows, and upskill peers.
Use AI-powered analytics to surface friction and anomalies in portal usage data and generate plain-language summaries for stakeholders.
Stay current with the evolving AI tooling landscape relevant to product management, operating at a higher output cadence than a traditional PM.
Delivery & Stakeholder Management
Drive agile delivery with engineering, design, and data using clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Manage dependencies with the billing, payout, financials, and data teams whose information the portal surfaces.
Coordinate with support and partner teams to make sure the portal reflects what merchants actually need.
Monitor product health via metrics such as adoption, task success, support deflection, and merchant satisfaction.

Strong product craft: discovery, design partnership, and a track record of shipping intuitive self-serve experiences.
Experience presenting complex or financial data clearly to non-technical users (for example transactions, payouts, or reporting).

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to guide the vision, strategy, and execution for Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR) within Elastic Security. Attackers not only break in - they log in. Identity is now a major target for attacks. These attacks can happen in on-premises setups, cloud environments, or with self-directed agents. Detecting and responding to identity-based attacks is essential for any modern Security Operations Center (SOC).
In this high-impact role, you will define how Elastic detects, investigates, and responds to identity-based threats, building on our Entity Analytics and Entity Store foundation to deliver a credible, differentiated ITDR function.

You will also own the roadmap for securing non-human and AI agent identities within Elastic Security, one of the fastest-growing and least-governed attack surfaces in the enterprise.

You will work at the intersection of identity, detection engineering, and AI, partnering with threat researchers, data scientists, and engineers, and evangelizing our approach to a global community of security practitioners.
What You Will Be Doing
Define and own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a credible ITDR function within Elastic Security, evolving our Entity Analytics and Entity Store foundation from behavioral analytics into an identity-defense outcome.
Manage the plan for non-human and AI agent identities in Elastic Security. This involves modeling service accounts, workloads, secrets, and self-directed agents as important identities. Each identity will have its own behavior standards, ownership, and lifecycle. You will also establish how to detect identities that operate continuously and at machine scale.
Work with threat research and detection engineering. Focus on identity-specific threats. These threats include credential access, privilege escalation, and identity-based lateral movement. They also involve the abuse of identity providers and tokens. Ensure that these threats relate to real-world adversary tactics.
Drive the response and containment strategy. This is the 'R' in ITDR. Turn detections into action. Use identity-system integrations and automated responses. Make sure there is human oversight for important actions.
Work closely with our enterprise customers. Collaborate with security operations teams, sales, and solution architects. Your goal is to understand the requirements for identity attacks. You will also discuss priorities and clarify product needs.
Work with the design team to develop investigation and response experiences. These experiences will emphasize identity in the analyst workflow. Integrate identity signals with endpoint, cloud, and network data in the SIEM and XDR functions of our security operations platform.
Gain deep knowledge of the identity-security market. Know its major trends and the changing threat landscape. Use this information to develop a unique strategy and engage with analysts.
Be the product expert and evangelize Elastic's identity capabilities through content such as blog posts, talks, and open community interaction.

Extensive Experience: 10+ years of experience in product management or solution delivery for security products such as SIEM, XDR, EDR, identity security, or detection and response. A consistent record of leading sophisticated, data-intensive products from inception through launch and iterative growth.
Identity Security Depth: A solid knowledge of identity-based attack techniques and the identity fabric. This includes Active Directory, cloud identity providers, SSO, OAuth, and privileged access. It also involves knowing how identity threats can occur in both on-premises and cloud environments. Knowledge of ITDR as a discipline and with entity behavioral analytics (UEBA).
You need to be fluent in non-human identities. This includes service accounts, workloads, secrets, and AI agents. You should also understand why traditional human-identity rules don't apply to identities that act independently and continuously.
AI and ML Fluency: Deep technical comprehension of the AI/ML landscape, including behavioral analytics, anomaly detection, LLMs, and agentic systems. You are comfortable working closely with data scientists and engineers, and you treat AI agents both as a subject to be secured and as a tool that consumes identity context.
Bias to action: You are able to advance fast and quickly learn from experiments and tests. You utilize AI tools to help accelerate your processes and bring clarity to your decisions.
Management and Influence: Demonstrated ability to lead across a matrixed organization, align multiple stakeholders toward a common vision, and drive execution in a dynamic, remote-first environment. You operate with the autonomy and judgment expected of a principal-level product leader.
Communication Excellence: Outstanding spoken and written communication skills and practices. You can distill complex detection engineering and identity concepts into compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive leadership.
Customer Obsession: An interest for industry trends and a commitment to solving real-world customer problems. You are an advocate for the security analyst and detection engineer, and you are focused on building products that help defenders stay ahead of identity-based threats.
