Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.
We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.
You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

This position sits on the Business Systems Product team in the CIO organization.
Verkada sells through partners. Two products carry that motion: the Verkada Store (vStore) , where partners quote, price, and order, and the Partner Portal , where partners run their Verkada business — registering deals, tracking orders and renewals, pulling pricebooks and inventory, requesting marketing funds, and reaching the training and enablement they need to sell. You own both. One partner experience, two surfaces.
Verkada's ambition is to be the easiest company in the industry to do business with, and the Store and the Portal are where that promise is either kept or broken. The bar is a system partners choose to use: intuitive enough to need almost no training, useful enough that nobody keeps a side spreadsheet, and scalable enough that order volume can grow faster than the supporting headcount growth.
This is a build role. vStore is homegrown and in active development, and partner self-service ordering is one of the company's primary levers to scale revenue without scaling headcount. You will own the roadmap end to end with a dedicated engineering team. Executives, Sales, Marketing, and Finance are all invested in these products, so success depends as much on building alignment as on shipping.
We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to be onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

Build streamlined features for pricing configurations, automated approvals, checkout, payments, and fund requests (MDF/JSF) to enable partners to operate without manual intervention.
Take full ownership of strategy, prioritization, PRDs, and user experience for both core partner platforms, from quote-to-order pathways to navigation and identity management.
Hold both products to a product standard, not an internal-tool standard. The honest measure is whether a partner would rather use the Store than call someone, and whether an internal user would rather use it than build a workaround.
Partner with Sales, Channel, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Deal Desk to translate needs into features and workflow changes across the full partner journey.
Talk to partners directly. Partner AEs, SEs, order admins, and finance admins each use these products differently, and the roadmap should reflect what they do, not what internal stakeholders assume they do.
Lead cross-functional requirements sessions to define functional scope. Surface the unspoken and conflicting requirements, and drive to a decision.
Directly impact key operational metrics—including board-level targets for self-service order adoption, reduced quote cycle times, straight-through order processing, and support ticket deflection across key partner personas.
Recommend changes to development and system standards that improve scalability and reduce maintenance burden.

Bachelor's degree in MIS, CS, Business, or other technical/analytical field.
Minimum 5+ years of experience, ideally including e-commerce, retail systems, or online storefront management.

Team
Join the FinOps Platform Engineering organization within Global Cloud Services (GCS), the team that builds ServiceNow’s internal FinOps Control Tower for cloud cost governance, financial accountability, and unit economics across our multi-cloud estate (AWS, Azure, and GCP).

Our organization is structured around three core teams: a Data Engineering and Data Lake team that builds the ELT pipelines landing data into our Iceberg lakehouse and owns data governance; a Platform Services team that operates our open-source platform stack (Trino, Lightdash, Coder, Jupyter, Redash, Hive Metastore/Nessie); and an Analytics Engineering team that builds the dbt data models and supports analysts creating dashboards and data apps.
This role supports the first two of those teams. You will be the product voice for the data engineering and platform services workstreams, working as a collaborative peer alongside the engineering leaders who own execution.
Role
As Senior Staff Technical Product Owner for FinOps Data Platform & Engineering, you own the product direction for both the data lake and ELT pipeline capabilities and the platform services that data engineers and analysts build on every day. You are the connective tissue between what the organization needs from its data foundation and what the engineering teams build.
This is a hands-on technical product role embedded in engineering. You will own the backlogs for two teams, translate requirements from internal users and FinOps stakeholders into concrete specifications, sequence the roadmap, and drive adoption. You will not manage people directly. You lead through influence, deep technical judgment, and close partnership with the engineering managers and senior engineers who own delivery.
Your stakeholders span both directions. Inward, you serve the data engineers, platform engineers, and analytics engineers who use the pipelines and platforms daily. Outward, you serve the FinOps practitioners, finance leaders, and capacity planners who depend on data landing reliably and platforms being available when they need them.
A defining part of the mandate is developer experience. The people building on this platform (data engineers using Coder workspaces, writing dbt models, running notebooks, querying Trino) are your users too. You will advocate for improvements to their workflows and partner with the platform services manager to make those improvements real.
You will also translate data governance requirements from compliance, security, and enterprise governance teams into actionable engineering work. You will not define governance policy, but you will ensure the platform and pipelines implement it correctly and completely.
The broader organization is migrating off Cloudera onto the modern lakehouse. You will partner closely with the Data Engineering team on this effort, jointly owning the sequencing of workload migration, defining readiness criteria for each wave, and coordinating stakeholder communication. The Principal Engineer leads the overall migration architecture, but you and the Data Engineering lead will drive the day-to-day prioritization and execution planning together.

s.h: What you get to do in this role
s.t:
Product Vision & Roadmap
Own the product vision and roadmap for FinOps data engineering (ELT pipelines, data lake, source onboarding) and platform services (Trino, Coder, Lightdash, Jupyter, Redash, Nessie).
Define what “production-ready” means for data pipelines and platform services. Establish SLAs for data freshness, pipeline reliability, and platform availability, and use them to steer prioritization.
Sequence the roadmap across both teams so that platform capabilities land ahead of the pipeline and analytics work that depends on them.
Gate roadmap phases on clear readiness criteria rather than arbitrary timelines. Ensure each phase builds on a proven foundation.
Data Engineering & Pipeline Product
Own requirements and prioritization for ELT pipeline development. Define which sources to onboard, in what order, and what the acceptance criteria are for each.
Specify the data contracts, quality expectations, and freshness SLAs for each pipeline, translating business needs into work the data engineering team can build and validate against.
Drive source onboarding to be fast and repeatable. Work with data engineers to templatize and automate the path from raw source to governed lakehouse table.
Translate data governance requirements (data classification, access control policies, lineage, retention) into concrete engineering specifications and acceptance criteria.
Ensure pipeline reliability is measurable and improving. Define the metrics, track them, and use them to prioritize investment in reliability over new features when needed.
Platform Services Product
Own requirements and prioritization for platform services alongside the platform services manager. Bring the user and stakeholder perspective; partner on feasibility and sequencing.
Define adoption and satisfaction targets for platform services. Understand how internal users experience Trino, Coder, Lightdash, and Jupyter, and drive improvements that reduce friction and increase self-service capability.
Advocate for developer experience improvements across the data engineering workflow. Identify pain points in how data engineers use workspaces, CI/CD, notebooks, and query tools, and work with the platform team to resolve them.
Drive platform service onboarding for new users and use cases, ensuring documentation, access provisioning, and initial support are smooth.
Stakeholder Management & Adoption
Serve as the primary intake point for requirements from FinOps practitioners, finance, capacity planning, and engineering teams that need data landed or platform capabilities extended.
Turn ambiguous asks into sequenced, shippable work with clear acceptance criteria. Push back on scope that doesn’t serve the roadmap, and negotiate timelines with stakeholders when needed.
Define the measurement model for success (pipeline SLA attainment, platform uptime, adoption breadth, source onboarding velocity, developer satisfaction) and report against it.
Communicate roadmap status, trade-offs, and dependencies to stakeholders in terms they can act on.
Migration & Cross-Team Alignment
Partner with the Data Engineering team on Cloudera-to-lakehouse migration planning, jointly owning wave sequencing, readiness criteria, and stakeholder communication for pipeline and platform workloads.
Coordinate with the Principal Engineer on overall migration architecture while driving the day-to-day prioritization and execution planning alongside Data Engineering leadership.
Align with the Analytics Engineering TPO (your peer) to ensure the data models and dashboards team has what it needs from the lake and platform layers.
Governance Translation
Translate enterprise data governance policies (from compliance, security, and data governance teams) into actionable specifications for the engineering teams.
Ensure data classification, access control, lineage tracking, and audit requirements are implemented in both the pipelines and the platform services.

Our offices are located in NYC, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle , Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore. We cultivate a people-centric culture focused on mastery, ownership, and transparency.

This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters are located) or anywhere in the US, including in any of our US offices listed above.
At YipitData, we value ownership and impact. Our Data Feeds & Quant business is one of the fastest-growing segments of YipitData. To accelerate that growth, we’re looking for a Product Manager to own and scale the platform on which our quant product efforts are built.
This role sits at the intersection of quant research, data products, engineering, and go-to-market. You will help turn proprietary and exclusively licensed alternative datasets - including transaction data, email receipt data, B2B spend data, and more - into standardized, client-ready factor and signal products for systematic investors.

This is not a maintenance role. You will help define the product shape of our quant platform, build the operating model around it, and bring a new class of products to market.
Our Feeds & Quant organization includes product managers, quant researchers, product specialists, feed operations, and product marketers. We collaborate closely with engineering partners, who own technical architecture, infrastructure, and implementation, as well as with Sales, CS, and Product Specialists. Together, we serve a wide range of systematic users - from sophisticated funds that want flexible building blocks to smaller managers that need more packaged, immediately usable products.

Quant Platform & Factor Library Development
Define and own the product spec for our factor library - including factor definitions, universe/coverage rules, methodology notes, historical evidence packs, factor exposure files, QA frameworks, and update cadence
Build and scale a standardized factor taxonomy (e.g., growth factors, acceleration/inflection factors, surprise/revision-type factors) across multiple proprietary datasets
Collaborate with our quant research team to perform deep diligence on datasets and publish high-alpha signal research , translating raw research into repeatable, productized factor pipelines
Sequence the factor library from an initial constrained beta toward a complete library with traditional baseline factor models, alt-data factors, and incremental attribution frameworks.
Signal-to-Pipeline Engineering Partnership
Take quant researcher signal research and collaborate with engineering partners to turn insights into repeatable, scalable factor computation and delivery pipelines
Define product requirements for factor infrastructure - including reference data dependencies, standardized identifiers, automated QA, and monitoring systems
Own the product-side accountability for ensuring factor pipelines are highly stable, accurate, and delivered on a consistent frequency
Customer Research & End-Market Strategy
Conduct deep customer research to understand key systematic end-user needs, feed architecture designs, integration requirements, and backtesting workflows
Translate customer insights into a product build and prioritization pipeline that serves the full spectrum of quant buyers - from large systematic multi-managers running bespoke models to smaller funds consuming pre-packaged signals
Support pricing, packaging, and competitive positioning decisions for quant products in partnership with GTM teams
Go-to-Market & Commercial Accountability
Partner closely with our revenue and product marketing teams to build GTM plans for signals and bring them to market - including client-ready case studies, evidence packs, and methodology documentation
Share ARR and P&L accountability alongside Product Specialists / Product Enablement partners for the quant products you own
Collaborate with Product Specialists (our product-sales translators) to enable sales motions, support client conversations, and scale enablement across the quant product portfolio
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with Engineering on technical approach, scaled infrastructure, delivery architecture, and reliability - you own strategy and direction; engineering owns implementation
Work closely with Quant Researchers , who function as a key internal customer providing research requirements, content, and deliverables for the external quant end market
Coordinate with Feed Operations on day-to-day delivery, incident management, and operational improvements
Partner with the CS team (who own feed retention and renewal) to drive retention, expansion, and client satisfaction

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible.

We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values.

As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey.

If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Technical Product Manager who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.
Sezzle is building the platform that will carry us from a BNPL provider into a full-stack financial institution. This role owns the system at the center of that: Sezzle ’s banking core — the ledger, accounts and balances, and the money movement that every future Sezzle financial product will run on.
You would own it end to end. Discovery, architecture and vendor decisions, requirements, build, launch, and everything after — not a slice of someone else’s roadmap, but the full product lifecycle for the platform itself. You’d work directly with Engineering, Finance, Compliance, Treasury, and Risk, with real authority over how this gets built.
Ideally you’ve built something like this before. If you haven’t, but you’ve owned a ledger, a payments platform, an issuing program, or other financial infrastructure — and you’re the kind of person who learns a domain properly rather than around the edges — we want to talk to you. What matters most is that you’ve owned real infrastructure and that you’re willing to go deep on the parts you don’t know yet.

Own the banking platform roadmap. Define and sequence the platform work required to support accounts, deposits, cards, and lending on a single ledger and account model.
Help drive the build-vs-buy decision. Evaluate core banking platforms and processors, run vendor diligence, model cost and time-to-market, and help leadership decide whether we extend what we have or integrate a third party.
Shape the account and ledger model. Work with Engineering and Finance on account hierarchies, sub-ledgers, chart-of-accounts mapping, posting rules, holds, interest and fee accrual, and general ledger integration.
Specify money movement. Own product requirements for transfers, ACH, card issuing and network settlement, real-time rails, and returns and reversals — including exception handling, cutoff windows, and settlement reconciliation.
Make the platform auditable. Ensure the system produces the reporting, traceability, and controls that Finance, audit, and regulators need — reconciliation breaks, balance attestation, and complete transaction history.
Partner on regulatory readiness. Work with Compliance and Legal to turn their requirements into platform capabilities: screening hooks, onboarding data, error resolution, disclosures and statements, and reporting. You don’t need to arrive fluent in US banking regulation — you do need to be someone who learns it properly.
Plan migration and cutover. If a migration is in scope, own data mapping, parallel-run strategy, validation criteria, rollback plans, and phased cutover.
Write the technical requirements. Own detailed specs, API contracts, event schemas, data models, user stories, and release plans end-to-end.

Du möchtest nicht einfach ein bestehendes Produkt weiterentwickeln, sondern eine neue technische Fähigkeit für unsere gesamte IT aufbauen? Dann könnte diese Rolle genau das Richtige für dich sein.
Mit deiner Leidenschaft für Softwareentwicklung, Automatisierung und CI/CD gestaltest du als technisch versierter Product Owner des System Teams unsere technischen Grundlagen, Plattformen und Standards rund um Software-Entwicklung und modernen IT Betrieb. Damit unterstützt du unsere Teams dabei, Applikationen und Software schneller, sicherer und mit höherer Qualität bereitzustellen.
### **Das erwartet dich** ###
In einer ersten Phase liegt dein Fokus auf drei zentralen Themen:
* Du verantwortest den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung standardisierter CI/CD-Pipelines für unsere zentralen Technologie-Stacks.
* Du definierst gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten verbindliche Mindeststandards für Code, Security und Automatisierung.
* Du unterstützt die Teams im Umgang mit Pipelines und Standards und sorgst dafür, dass diese verständlich, nutzbar und wirksam verankert werden.
In einem nächsten Schritt entwickelst du das System Team gezielt weiter zu einem zentralen Enabler für weitere Teile des Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC):
* Du treibst die Automatisierung über den gesamten Entwicklungs- und Lieferprozess voran.
* Du förderst professionelle Softwareentwicklung mit klaren Standards, wirksamer Automatisierung und einem hohen Reifegrad.
* Du identifizierst Themenfelder mit hohem Nutzen, priorisierst sie und entwickelst sie gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter - zum Beispiel in den Bereichen Testmanagement, Umgebungsmanagement, Release-Management oder Entwicklungsstandards.
* Du schaffst die Grundlage für einheitliche Rahmenbedingungen, Best Practices und wiederverwendbare Lösungen.
* Du sorgst dafür, dass das System Team mit den Anforderungen der Organisation mitwächst und seine Wirkung laufend weiterentwickelt und gezielt ausdehnt.
### **Das bringst du mit** ###
* Du besitzt ein ausgezeichnetes Verständnis für moderne Softwareentwicklung, technische Plattformen und organisationsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit.
* Du denkst strategisch und bist gleichzeitig in der Umsetzung technisch wirksam.
* Du verstehst die Anforderungen moderner Softwareentwicklung und bringst fundierte, mehrjährige Erfahrung in Themen wie CI/CD, Automatisierung, Testing, Release-Management, Integration und DevOps mit - idealerweise aus komplexen Organisationen.
* Du bewegst dich sicher in anspruchsvollen IT-Landschaften - auch im Zusammenspiel von Standardsoftware, Eigenentwicklungen, Cloud-Services und On-Prem-Systemen.
* Du kannst eine klare Produkte-Vision erarbeiten und technische Themen strukturieren, priorisieren und in eine umsetzbare Roadmap übersetzen.
* Du agierst sicher in einem Umfeld mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern und schaffst es, gemeinsame Ziele und verbindliche Leitplanken zu etablieren und wirksam in einer Organisation zu verankern.
* Du denkst strategisch, bleibst aber in der Umsetzung pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert. Du erkennst, wo Standardisierung sinnvoll ist und wo Teams den nötigen Freiraum brauchen.
* Du beherrschst die deutsche Sprache und kommunizierst klar, adressatengerecht sowie überzeugend.
### **Dein nächster Schritt** ###

Neho est l'une des principales sociétés de courtage immobilier en Suisse, redéfinissant le secteur grâce à l'innovation. Nous combinons l'expertise humaine avec des solutions numériques puissantes pour offrir une expérience immobilière plus rapide, plus transparente et plus efficace.

Notre approche a été reconnue par des prix prestigieux, dont le SEF Award 2023. Ce qui nous distingue vraiment, c'est notre modèle à prix fixe, offrant aux clients une alternative moderne aux services traditionnels basés sur la commission, propulsée par une technologie avancée.
**Nous recherchons un ingénieur produit IA pour diriger, de manière pratique, la mise en œuvre de l'IA. Vous construirez les agents qui prennent en charge les parties manuelles et répétitives de l'achat, du financement et de la vente d'une maison, afin que nos experts puissent consacrer leur temps aux moments qui comptent.**
Vous ne partirez pas de zéro. Nous avons une vision convaincante et des prototypes fonctionnels. Votre mission est de faire passer ce modèle du prototype au produit : agents réels, utilisateurs réels, résultats mesurés. Vous mettrez en production un premier agent dans vos premiers mois et développerez un pipeline à partir de là.
**Il s'agit d'un rôle de zéro à un avec une véritable responsabilité et visibilité, relevant directement de notre CTO. Si vous aimez transformer un processus manuel en logiciel fonctionnel livré en semaines plutôt qu'en trimestres, vous vous sentirez chez vous ici.**
**Charge de travail : 80 - 100%**
## **Ingénieur Produit IA** ##
### **Vos tâches** ###
* **Trouver la valeur :** Passez du temps réel avec les chefs de produit, conseillers, agents immobiliers et spécialistes des opérations, cartographiez leurs flux de travail, identifiez les cas d'utilisation des agents qui éliminent le plus de travail mesurable tout au long du parcours client ou des opérations internes - priorisez par résultat
* **Construire les agents, de manière pratique :** Concevez, construisez, testez et déployez les agents vous-même : utilisez des frameworks et plateformes d'agents là où ils sont plus rapides, du code réel là où ils ne le sont pas
* **Assumer la livraison des interfaces :** Faites passer nos prototypes au produit, et faites évoluer la manière dont les agents atteignent les utilisateurs : dans le produit, en chat, puis plus tard sur mobile
* **Construire la couche MCP :** Enveloppez les API stables du domaine dans des outils MCP fins et bien conçus à travers lesquels vos agents agissent. Vous êtes le premier et le plus exigeant consommateur de notre architecture API-first.
* **Conduire les exigences vers les équipes :** Spécifiez les API dont vos agents et interfaces ont besoin auprès des équipes d'ingénierie propriétaires du domaine, qui les construisent et les exposent ; vous consommez des contrats propres plutôt que d'accéder directement aux systèmes
* **Choisir la plateforme avec l'équipe Platform :** Dirigez la sélection de la technologie et des plateformes conjointement avec l'équipe Platform, en tenant compte de la sécurité, de la protection des données suisse/UE, du coût et de l'opérabilité
* **Livrer sur rails, dans les limites :** Déployez sur le chemin cloisonné, containerisé et uniquement API de l'entreprise ; instrumentez et évaluez vos agents ; respectez les niveaux de sensibilité des données
* **Transférer quand un agent grandit :** Quand un agent devient critique pour les revenus ou touche des données client ou financières sensibles, transférez-le à l'ingénierie pour durcissement et prise en charge à long terme, et continuez à construire le suivant
* **Mesurer les résultats :** Suivez l'effort supprimé, le temps de cycle et l'impact sur la conversion, ainsi que l'adoption par les personnes servies par les agents. Pas le nombre d'agents livrés
#### **Ce que ce rôle n'est pas** ####
* **Pas le constructeur des API principales :** Les équipes d'ingénierie du domaine possèdent et exposent les API stables ; vous conduisez les exigences, construisez les fines enveloppes MCP par-dessus, et consommez les contrats
* **Pas le propriétaire de la plateforme/infrastructure :** La plateforme possède l'exécution, le déploiement, l'observabilité et la sécurité ; vous construisez par-dessus
* **Pas un service d'assistance IA :** Vous n'êtes pas là pour construire des outils sur mesure pour chaque département ; vous construisez les agents qui font avancer nos priorités, et aidez les autres à s'auto-servir en toute sécurité sur le chemin autorisé
### **Ce que nous offrons** ###
* Responsabilité complète de votre produit avec l'autorité pour piloter la mise en œuvre, challenger le statu quo, et assumer le résultat de la conception au lancement de nouvelles fonctionnalités
* Une opportunité de carrière unique pour rejoindre une scale-up en forte croissance et primée dans le secteur immobilier
* Façonnez l'avenir de la technologie immobilière en Suisse : Ayez un impact direct sur la croissance de Neho, et livrez des outils IA efficaces et évolutifs qui donnent à Neho un avantage concurrentiel
* Profitez de hiérarchies plates, de processus décisionnels rapides, et de la liberté de travailler de manière autonome et de laisser votre empreinte
* Faites partie d'une équipe dynamique et tournée vers l'avenir, répartie entre nos bureaux de Lausanne et Zurich ainsi que notre équipe d'ingénierie à distance en Roumanie
* Épanouissez-vous dans une culture entrepreneuriale et innovante qui valorise la transparence, l'équité et un fort soutien d'équipe
* Avantages compétitifs incluant 5 semaines de congés + jours supplémentaires selon l'ancienneté, congé maternité/paternité entièrement payé, options de télétravail, événements d'équipe réguliers, et plus encore !
### **Ce que vous apportez** ###
* **Maîtrise de la pile IA :** Vous avez travaillé avec la pile IA moderne sous une forme ou une autre (API directes de modèles, frameworks d'agents comme LangGraph/CrewAI/Google ADK, plateformes d'orchestration comme Dify/n8n). Ce qui compte, c'est ce que vous avez livré, pas l'outil utilisé.
* **Développeur dans l'âme :** Vous avez une formation en ingénierie logicielle et écrivez et gérez du code en production depuis des années. Le langage spécifique importe peu.
* **À l'aise sur toute la pile :** Que ce soit PHP, TypeScript/JavaScript ou Python, vous êtes à l'aise pour construire des applications, des API et d'autres choses comme des extensions de navigateur ou même des applications mobiles.
* **Pragmatique sur les outils :** Vous utilisez les plateformes d'agents et outils IA là où ils sont plus rapides, et écrivez du code réel là où ils ne le sont pas. À l'aise avec MCP, webhooks, prompting et interfaces utilisateur en streaming.
* **Discipliné sur l'évaluation :** Vous avez livré des systèmes basés sur LLM à de vrais utilisateurs : vous écrivez des évaluations, concevez des quadrails, pensez aux modes de défaillance, et savez quand un agent doit refuser de répondre. YipitData is making one of its most ambitious Product bets: building an AI-powered product that transforms how clients interact with data. This initiative sits at the center of our product strategy and represents a fundamentally new way for customers to access and derive value from our data.
As a Data Product Manager, you will play a pivotal role in making that vision a reality. You will own the path from raw alternative data to trusted, product ready intelligence—determining how complex datasets are structured, interpreted, and ultimately surfaced to customers.
This role sits at the intersection of data, product, and AI. You will work with diverse alternative datasets and develop the methodologies that transform those signals into reliable business insights. You will also serve as a key authority on how the product uses data, helping define what conclusions are methodologically sound, what questions can be answered confidently, and where appropriate guardrails should exist.
Success in this role requires both analytical rigor and a builder's mindset. You'll thrive in ambiguity, tackle problems without established playbooks, and help shape the future of one of YipitData's most strategic products. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of customers interact with our data and how this product scales over time.

Data Source Ownership & Methodology Design
Own the translation of raw alternative datasets into scalable, AIready data products.
Design methodologies that answer high-value business questions, determining how disparate datasets should be combined, normalized, and interpreted.
Partner closely with Data Engineering to shape source data pipelines into clean, well-structured datasets with clear definitions and documentation.
Develop deep expertise in the strengths, limitations, biases, and coverage characteristics of key datasets and ensure those nuances are reflected in downstream outputs.
AI Product Intelligence & Knowledge Systems
Define how the product should use different datasets, including valid query patterns, edge cases, failure modes, and methodological guardrails.
Own metric definitions, data lineage, and documentation to ensure the product consistently delivers accurate and explainable answers.
Establish standards for how the product reasons across multiple datasets, preventing over-interpretation and ensuring conclusions remain statistically defensible.
Serve as the final reviewer for methodology-related changes that impact product behavior.
Product Development & Customer Problem Solving
Translate customer questions into scalable methodologies, data models, and product capabilities.
Expand the range of questions the product can answer by enabling new forms of segmentation, cohort analysis, behavioral measurement, and cross-dataset insights.
Partner with Product, Engineering, and Leadership to identify new data sources, use cases, and capabilities that increase the commercial value of the AI product.
Help shape the product roadmap by turning emerging customer needs and experimental insights into repeatable product functionality.
Data Quality & Operational Excellence
Coordinate testing and validation of staged data changes before they reach production.
Own incident management processes for data quality issues, methodology changes, and upstream source disruptions.
Build and maintain a library of quality checks tailored to the unique requirements of AI-powered customer experiences.
Ensure the product consistently surfaces reliable, accurate, and internally consistent information across all supported use cases.
You Are Likely to Succeed If You Have
3–6 years of experience in data product management, product analytics, analytics engineering, data science, market intelligence, alternative data, or a closely related field.
Strong fluency in SQL; comfort with data pipelines, schema changes, and upstream/downstream data dependencies.
Experience owning data documentation, metric definitions, or data quality programs—not just conducting ad hoc analysis.
A track record of cross-functional coordination, ideally between technical data teams and product or commercial stakeholders.
Strong project management instincts: you can run a triage process, maintain a quality library, and coordinate across multiple stakeholder groups without dropping balls.
Clear, structured communication—you can translate complex data methodology questions into guidance that non-technical stakeholders can act on.
A demonstrable track record of building—shipping things, solving hard problems, and leaving a clear mark on the products you’ve worked on.
An entrepreneurial mindset: you’re comfortable with ambiguity, energized by new problem spaces, and don’t need a fully paved road to make progress.
Deep experience with alternative data, panel data, or similarly complex, nuanced data sources is required—you need to understand the quirks, limitations, and methodological subtleties of these datasets and be able to encode that understanding for an AI driven product.
Prior experience in or exposure to AI/ML products, LLM-based agents, or evaluation frameworks is a strong plus.

Bei Bosch gestalten wir Zukunft mit hochwertigen Technologien und Dienstleistungen, die Begeisterung wecken und das Leben der Menschen verbessern. Unser Versprechen an dich steht dabei felsenfest: Wir wachsen gemeinsam, haben Freude an unserer Arbeit und inspirieren uns gegenseitig.
sia Abrasives ist ein international tätiges Unternehmen der Bosch\-Gruppe und einer der führenden Schleifmittelhersteller weltweit. Wir entwickeln, produzieren und vertreiben hochwertige Schleifmittel sowie kundenorientierte Systemlösungen zum Erzielen perfekter Oberflächen. Stellenbeschreibung
In dieser spannenden Position übernimmst du die Funktion des Junior\-Produktmanagers für definierte Produktserien. Du wirst von Beginn an in das Management unseres ganzheitlichen Produktlebenszyklus eingebunden und übernimmst schrittweise die Verantwortung für dein eigenes Portfolio.

Produkt\- \& Portfolioverantwortung: Du treibst aktiv den Erfolg deiner Produktlinien voran, agierst als kompetenter Ansprechpartner für dein Portfolio und unterstützt den Vertrieb bei technischen Anfragen.
Eigenständige (Teil\-)Projektleitung: Du übernimmst schrittweise selbstständige Leitung kleinerer Projekte (z. B. die Koordination von Produktänderungen, länderspezifische Produkteinführungen oder die Erstellung neuer Demo\-Kits für den Vertrieb) und stellst deren Erfolg hinsichtlich Qualität, Kosten und Terminen sicher.
Nutzerzentrierte Innovation: Durch die Analyse von Kundenfeedback und das Erkennen von Nutzerbedürfnissen (User Experience / UX) formulierst du innovative Produkt\- und Lösungskonzepte.
Markt\- \& Wettbewerbsbeobachtung: Du erarbeitest dir ein tiefes Verständnis über unsere globalen Zielmärkte, Zielgruppen und Wettbewerber, um strategische Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten.

Datenmanagement: Du stellst die hohe Qualität und Pflege produktrelevanter Stammdaten in unseren Systemen sicher, um der Kommunikationsabteilung und dem Vertrieb optimale Verkaufsunterlagen bereitzustellen.

As the Senior Product Manager for Capital Management, you will play a critical role in building the infrastructure that powers how private funds move and track capital—from capital calls to distributions, treasury workflows to accounting integrations.

These are some of the most high-stakes and operationally intensive processes fund managers handle, and you’ll help make them seamless, scalable, and audit-ready. Your work will directly contribute to our mission of reshaping private markets through modern, intuitive software.
This is a high-impact position where you’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to build products that deliver tangible value, including engineering, design, operations, and customer success.

Define and drive the product roadmap for capital-related workflows, including capital calls, distributions, treasury, and accounting integrations
Identify opportunities to transform complex operational processes into intuitive product experiences, automation logic, and scalable infrastructure

Translate customer insights into precise product requirements and user stories
Partner with engineering and design teams to deliver high-quality products on time.
Serve as the primary point of contact for all product-related decisions
Ensure cross-functional alignment and effective communication throughout the product lifecycle
Define success metrics and use data to track product performance and inform decision-making
Continuously gather feedback to iterate and improve our product
Stay ahead of industry trends in fund finance, treasury tools, and accounting systems to identify new opportunities for innovation

Experience owning mission-critical, data-intensive product areas with high compliance or audit requirements

### **V-ZUG Procurement** ###
Der Bereich Procurement verantwortet die strategische Beschaffung von Materialien, Komponenten und Dienstleistungen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Als Schweizer Premiumhersteller mit eigener Produktion am Hauptsitz in Zug stellen wir hohe Anforderungen an unsere Lieferanten - und an uns selbst.

Unser Einkauf ist entsprechend professionell aufgestellt: mit klaren Kategorienstrukturen, einem internationalen Lieferantennetzwerk und dem Anspruch, nicht nur Kosten zu optimieren, sondern Partnerschaften zu gestalten, die langfristig tragen.
### **Das bietet dir die Stelle** ###
* Du entwickelst und setzt die Warengruppen- und Lieferantenstrategie für deine Kategorien um - nicht als Verwaltungsaufgabe, sondern als echte Gestaltungsaufgabe: Du entscheidest, welche Lieferanten V-ZUG langfristig begleiten, wo neue Quellen erschlossen werden und wie die Materialversorgung auch in einem volatilen Markt stabil bleibt
* Du steuerst dein Lieferantenportfolio über den gesamten Lebenszyklus - von der Auswahl neuer Partner über gezielte Weiterentwicklung bis zur Ausphasung. Gemeinsam mit dem Supplier Quality Management sorgst du dafür, dass Anspruch und Realität übereinstimmen - durch regelmässige Bewertungen und Audits, die mehr sind als ein Pflichtprogramm
* Du verantwortest das Vertragsmanagement in deinen zugewiesenen Warengruppen im Bereich Mechanik - von der Erstellung über die Verhandlung bis zur laufenden Pflege. Du weisst, was in einem Vertrag wirklich zählt, und bringst interne Stakeholder auf einen gemeinsamen Nenner
* Du führst Ausschreibungen durch, vergleichst Angebote und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen fundierte Vergabeempfehlungen und Entscheidungen, die wirtschaftliche und technische Anforderungen optimal vereinen
* Du hast die Kostenentwicklung deiner Vorserien- und Serienartikel im Griff: Du erkennst Potenziale frühzeitig, nutzt sie konsequent und setzt Massnahmen um, die nachhaltig wirken
* Du bist fester Bestandteil von Projekten, koordinierst Materialbedarfe mit Lieferanten und stellst sicher, dass Muster, Prototypen und Serienmaterialien dann da sind, wenn sie gebraucht werden
### **Das bringst du für die Stelle mit** ###
* Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Betriebswirtschaft, Supply Chain Management oder einer vergleichbaren Disziplin
* Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Einkauf mit und weisst, wie man Lieferanten gegenüber souverän Position bezieht - mit Verhandlungsgeschick, das nicht laut sein muss, um zu wirken, und einer Kommunikation, die intern wie extern ankommt

## Contribuez à façonner l'avenir du travail chez BOBST ##
Chez BOBST, nous transformons la manière dont nos collaborateurs collaborent, communiquent et utilisent l'IA pour travailler plus intelligemment chaque jour.
Nous recherchons un **Responsable Produit des Plateformes de Travail Numérique et de Communication** qui pilotera l'évolution de notre écosystème de travail numérique et soutiendra notre ambition de faire de la collaboration, de la communication et de l'IA une partie intégrante de l'expérience employé à travers le Groupe.
C'est une opportunité unique de combiner **Travail Numérique, Microsoft 365, Expérience Employé et Intelligence Artificielle** dans un rôle stratégique international.
## Votre mission ##
En tant que Responsable Produit, vous définirez et piloterez la feuille de route des solutions de Travail Numérique de BOBST, en veillant à ce que nos collaborateurs disposent des bons outils pour collaborer efficacement et rester connectés.
Vous superviserez nos plateformes de collaboration et de communication, incluant Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, notre Intranet d'entreprise et les solutions de productivité IA telles que Microsoft 365 Copilot.
En étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes métier, les équipes IT et les experts en communication, vous transformerez les besoins en solutions innovantes créant de la valeur à travers l'organisation.
## Vos principales responsabilités ##
* Définir et gérer la feuille de route et les priorités du Travail Numérique.
* Conduire l'évolution des plateformes de collaboration Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Viva).
* Être propriétaire et améliorer continuellement l'Intranet d'entreprise et les plateformes de communication employé.
* Piloter le déploiement et la gouvernance de Microsoft 365 Copilot et autres solutions de productivité IA.
* Assurer une expérience employé de haute qualité grâce à des outils de collaboration et de communication efficaces.
* Surveiller l'adoption et la performance des plateformes via des KPIs clairs et des analyses.
* Gérer les partenaires externes, les budgets et les prestataires de services.
* Travailler étroitement avec les parties prenantes de l'organisation pour délivrer des solutions impactantes.
## Ce que vous apportez ##
* Une expérience significative dans le Travail Numérique, Microsoft 365 ou les plateformes de collaboration.
* Une solide connaissance de Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online et de l'écosystème Microsoft 365.
* Une expérience en tant que Responsable Produit ou dans un rôle similaire pilotant des produits et services digitaux.
* Un intérêt pour les solutions de productivité alimentées par l'IA et l'expérience employé.
* De fortes compétences en gestion des parties prenantes et en communication.
* Maîtrise de l'anglais et du français.

Chez BOBST, vous rejoindrez un leader technologique mondial où l'innovation, la collaboration et l'apprentissage continu guident tout ce que nous faisons.

* Diriger des initiatives stratégiques en Travail Numérique et IA.

About 9fin
9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.
Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.
Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.
We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.
The Opportunity
9fin has built one of the most comprehensive datasets in credit and debt markets: news, financials, cap tables, instrument data, legal documents, and ESG analysis. Today, most clients access that data through 9fin.com .

But a large and growing segment of the market wants to consume our data programmatically to power firm-level workflows at scale: a negative news signal triggers an automated credit review, updated financials trigger a portfolio rebalance, a covenant keyword triggers a sanctions flag.
These buyers (quant desks, data engineering teams, systematic investors, risk and compliance functions) will never log into a web application. They need APIs, data feeds, and cloud-native delivery through platforms like Snowflake. At comparable financial data providers, this distribution channel represents 20-30% of total revenue. 9fin is at the beginning of this journey.
The challenge is to turn 9fin's integrated dataset into a portfolio of standalone data products with a coherent commercial strategy.

You will define how the data gets packaged (what goes together, what stands alone, how it's tiered and priced), the order in which products go to market, and the commercial models that fit each buyer segment: quant desks, data engineering teams, risk and compliance functions, and systematic investors.

You will work in lockstep with the Head of Pre-Sales, who owns technical validation and deal execution, to ensure that what you build maps to how these buyers actually evaluate and procure data.

The first candidates pan news content, financials and cap tables, instrument data, and legal data (complex, high-value, and genuinely unsolved at the data representation layer).
You will work cross-functionally across our platform teams, analytics engineering, and the domain squads that own the underlying datasets. You will also work closely with Sales to support a fundamentally different GTM motion: solution-selling with partner clients, joint POCs, multi-stakeholder deals, and usage-based commercial models rather than seat-based subscriptions.
This is a 0-to-1 build. If you have built API or data products before and want to do it again in a market where the opportunity is wide open, this is it.

Product Strategy & Execution
Define the product vision and strategy for 9fin's external data distribution: APIs, data shares, and future delivery mechanisms (cloud sync, pub/sub).
Own the data catalogue decisions: which datasets to expose, in what format, through which channels, and in what order, balancing client demand, data readiness, and commercial potential
Design the developer experience end-to-end: API design, documentation, developer portal, sandbox/playground, error handling, rate limiting, and versioning
Work with analytics engineering and domain teams to define schemas, data models, and transformation logic that make 9fin's data consumable and valuable outside the application
Use a partner model to validate early: select and work closely with 1-2 clients during development to co-develop and prove out each data product before broader launch
Shape the commercial model for API products: packaging, tiering, usage-based pricing, distribution controls, and entitlement structures that capture the value of programmatic data access
Data Quality, Infrastructure & Compliance
Partner with the Head of Analytics to ensure data products meet the reliability, freshness, and accuracy standards that enterprise clients building automated systems expect
Define SLAs for data delivery (latency, uptime, completeness) and build the monitoring and metering infrastructure to back them up
Own the entitlements and access control layer: ensuring the right clients can access the right data under the right contractual terms, with appropriate usage limits and controls
Work with Legal to define data usage policies, including restrictions on redistribution, AI training and model embedding, and onward use, protecting 9fin's data IP while enabling legitimate client workflows
Establish feedback loops between API consumers and domain teams so that usage patterns and client requests improve the underlying data over time
Cross-Functional Leadership & GTM
Coordinate across platform engineering, analytics engineering, domain squads, and the Head of Analytics to align priorities and ship a cohesive product without a dedicated squad
Influence teams you do not manage; build relationships that make cross-functional delivery work despite competing priorities
Support the shift to a solution-selling GTM motion: work with Sales and Customer Success on partner selection, POC design, technical onboarding, and commercial structuring for API deals
Engage directly with enterprise clients and their technical teams during pilots and integrations; this is a client-facing role, not a back-office one
Communicate strategy, progress, and trade-offs transparently to leadership, engineering, and commercial teams
Translate technical API and data infrastructure concepts into language that non-technical stakeholders (Sales, Legal, Finance) can act on

5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years building API products, data platforms, or data distribution products at a B2B company
Experience designing APIs for external consumers: you have opinions on schema design, versioning strategies, rate limiting, and what makes developer documentation actually useful
Track record of shipping data products where you managed the full lifecycle: from defining what data to expose, through schema design, to commercial packaging and client onboarding
Understanding of data infrastructure concepts: data pipelines, warehouses, ETL/ELT, data modelling, and platforms like Snowflake
Comfortable with SQL and Python and capable of interrogating data to validate quality, understand usage patterns, and inform product decisions
Experience working in a solution-selling or partner-led GTM model: you have been involved in POCs, pilots, or co-development with enterprise clients, not just self-serve product launches
Proven ability to lead cross-functionally without a dedicated team: you coordinate across engineering, data, and commercial functions through influence, not authority

Tu trabajo será diseñar un producto escalable que soporte los volúmenes de compra, mejorar la experiencia de cobro en puntos de venta físicos, y asegurar que esos flujos aterricen correctamente en el ERP.
El foco principal está en los productos que tocan directamente al cliente: facturación, pagos, autofacturación y validación documental para aprobación de órdenes de compra. También supervisarás el performance del equipo de finanzas pegado al journey comercial e identificarás oportunidades de mejora en SLAs de respuesta.

Responsabilidades
Diseñar y evolucionar un producto de finanzas escalable, alineado a los volúmenes y la operación multipaís de Kavak
Mejorar la experiencia de cobro al cliente en puntos de venta físicos y asegurar la correcta conciliación hacia el ERP
Evolucionar el producto de validación documental para aprobación de órdenes de compra, reduciendo el SLA de respuesta al journey comercial y los errores de registración
Identificar oportunidades de mejora en procesos de facturación, pagos y autofacturación para el cliente
Supervisar el performance del producto y del equipo de finanzas pegado al journey comercial
Gestionar la relación con proveedores, pasarelas de pago y bancos para evolucionar las capacidades del producto
Traducir necesidades del negocio en roadmap de producto con criterio financiero y orientación al cliente
Requisitos
Mínimo 5-6 años de experiencia en Product Management con foco en flujos financieros
Experiencia en productos client-facing: facturación, pagos, cobros, autofacturación
Conocimiento de flujos financieros: order to cash, procure to pay, record to report
Conocimiento del ecosistema de pagos: pasarelas, dispersiones, cash in
Experiencia trabajando con bancos y proveedores de soluciones financieras
Experiencia asegurando que flujos de pago concilien correctamente hacia ERPs
Plus
Experiencia en empresas de hipercrecimiento o marketplaces con operación física
Experiencia construyendo productos de autofacturación o facturación electrónica en México (CFDI)
Conocimiento de flujos de procurement

Versatilidad y adaptación al cambio: te movés bien en entornos donde las prioridades evolucionan rápido
Autonomía e independencia: avanzás sin necesitar validación constante
Capacidad de búsqueda de soluciones: sabés evaluar y seleccionar proveedores, no solo definir requerimientos
Curiosidad genuina: querés entender el problema de fondo, no solo cerrar el ticket

Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.
As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.
Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

Synthesia ships more product, faster, than we ever have. AI has collapsed the cost of building which means the hard part is no longer making things, it’s making sure people actually adopt them. That’s the job of Growth, and we’re changing how we do it: instead of bolting Growth on after launch to optimise, we’re embedding a Growth PM into every core bet from day one, so how a product acquires, activates and scales is designed in from the first cycle.
We’re hiring a Growth Product Manager to report to our VP of Growth. You'll own the Growth surface for one of those bets while helping build a growth-led way of working across the company.
What you’ll be doing
Own Growth for a core product area end to end, acquisition, activation, adoption and retention, baked into the roadmap from the start, not retrofitted.
Partner closely with the core product PMs and engineers who own the surface, bringing high-impact growth ideas and working out where they fit, and getting the primitives exposed that let you build and scale on top.
Design growth into the product itself: discovery-led acquisition loops, and experiences that get users to their job-to-be-done in a couple of clicks (sometimes without opening the editor at all).
Rally teams around specific, measurable outcomes and help each one hit its goal faster through what you build together.
Work across engineering, marketing and GTM to make funnel- and journey-thinking a normal part of how we build.

AI-native. You’ve driven AI into how a product or team works - not just worked somewhere that does AI. You use it daily, you’re curious about how the stack works, and you keep up as it moves (fast).
Scrappy and comfortable in ambiguity. You’ve taken something 0→1, you move fast, and you don’t need a clean brief or a stable roadmap to make progress. Constant change energises you rather than blocking you.
A builder of credibility. You win trust across teams quickly and can get engineers, PMs and GTM aligned around growth - even when that’s a new way of working for them.
Technically fluent and genuinely curious. You can hold your own with engineers on how things work and where the trade-offs are.
Outcome-driven. You anchor on the right metric and move it.

Experience as a Product Manager with exposure to Growth. Depth in a single specific lever is a plus, not a prerequisite.
Demonstrable experience driving AI-native product or ways of working.
Comfortable in a fast-moving, 0→1, frequently-disrupted environment.
Strong communication and the personality to build credibility and influence across functions.
Technical fluency to partner credibly with engineering.
Location
Remote from Europe or hybrid based from our London or Munich offices.

s.h: Your Mission This is a company built for growth, not comfort.
s.t:
When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.
We build high-performing consumer products in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming, leading one of its largest innovations, a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences.
Senior Product Manager (f/m/x) isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform.

Product at exmox means understanding the bigger business picture, considering cross-functional impact across Engineering, Data, Marketing, and Operations, and turning strategy into product decisions that create real value, knowing every change you ship affects millions of users.

At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.
If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.
What You’ll Own: Own one of exmox's highest-impact product domains end-to-end, shaping the reward economy through payout thresholds, tiering, bonuses, promotions, and other key levers that drive profitability.
Drive activation, retention, and long-term engagement through onboarding experiences, streaks, quests, progression systems, reactivation flows, and other lifecycle initiatives.
Take new growth opportunities from first hypothesis to go/no-go decision, across product, market expansion, partnerships, and distribution.
Lead a high-quality experimentation process by defining hypotheses, designing statistically sound A/B tests, interpreting results, and making data-driven product decisions.
Partner closely with your dedicated Data Analyst to uncover opportunities, validate assumptions, and continuously improve product performance.
Work with Engineering, Design, Commercial, User Acquisition, Customer Support, Fraud, and Leadership to align priorities and deliver impactful product improvements.
Represent your product domain directly to leadership, using data, customer insights, and business context to influence strategic decisions.
What Success Looks Like: You take ownership quickly: Within your first months, you've become the trusted owner of a critical product domain, confidently driving priorities, making decisions, and reducing dependency on leadership.
Growth metrics measurably improve: Your product strategy and experimentation drive meaningful improvements in activation, retention, and long-term user profitability.
Product decisions are driven by data: Experiments, user insights, and product analytics provide clear evidence to prioritize opportunities, validate ideas, and confidently decide what to scale - or stop.
Cross-functional teams are aligned around outcomes: You partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and User Acquisition to deliver product improvements that balance user value with business impact.
You turn ambitious ideas into scalable growth: Through structured experimentation, clear prioritization, and continuous optimization, you build product experiences that become repeatable growth levers for the business.
You outgrow the role: We are hiring for the ceiling, not just the opening. This role is scoped to grow - mentoring other product managers first, and leading a product team as we scale, if that is the direction you want to take.
What You Bring Experienced: You bring 5+ years of Product Management experience in consumer-facing digital products, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, marketplaces, subscriptions, ad-tech, fintech, or other high-growth B2C businesses. You have owned consumer product at scale - hundreds of thousands of monthly active users or more.
Business-Oriented: You understand that product decisions are business decisions. You're comfortable balancing user needs, commercial objectives, and technical constraints to maximize long-term value.
Fluent in Incentives: You have a real feel for why people come back and what makes a reward feel worth the effort. You have designed incentive, reward or progression mechanics and calibrated them so they motivate without eroding margin.
Experimentation-Driven: You have extensive experience running A/B tests, defining hypotheses, interpreting data, and making evidence-based product decisions. Statistical thinking comes naturally to you.
Data-Literate: You're comfortable working with product metrics and collaborating closely with analysts to uncover insights, measure success, and prioritize opportunities.
Strategic & Hands-on: You enjoy defining product strategy while remaining deeply involved in execution - from writing specifications and refining solutions to reviewing experiment results and driving delivery.
Collaborative: You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Commercial, and Leadership, bringing people together around clear product goals.
Intellectually Honest: You're comfortable working in ambiguity, take ownership without waiting for direction, and thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve quickly. You also kill your own ideas when the data says so - being wrong early is cheaper than being right late.
How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.
Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

At Huge, the Strategy craft is a multidisciplinary engine powered by elite strategists, product managers, marketing specialists, and insights experts. We sit at the intersection of business intelligence and innovation—unraveling complex business challenges to architect actionable, durable strategies that propel our clients forward.

Moving beyond static decks and traditional consulting deliverables, our team directly bridges the gap between high-level management consulting and groundbreaking, transformational execution.
Our approach melds product and digital experience strategy with corporate growth, data consulting, and brand innovation. We cultivate deeply collaborative, C-level client partnerships that culminate in outsized success and market transformation. At Huge, our mandate is to ensure that creative innovation and product execution are unshakably grounded in research, delivering tangible commercial value while keeping our clients ahead of rapidly shifting market dynamics.

Huge is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Product Management craft. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional crafts to define the core product vision, goals, functionality, and requirements while establishing a shared set of objectives by building collective consensus on priorities leading to product delivery and beyond.

Define and manage product roadmaps to realize business goals and strategies.
Collaborate with user experience experts, visual designers, and engineers to reach the best possible version of a feature to bring to market.
Create and maintain feature backlogs, and product documentation such as PRDs, user stories, use cases, user flows, logic flows, and functional specifications.
Prioritize development activities with engineering teams, assist in determining the best technical implementation methods, work closely with QA on acceptance testing, and lead product launches.
Validate & identify strategic opportunities through research, data analysis, A/B testing, competitive research and other relevant tools.
Act as the voice of the user and key stakeholders during day to day aspects of product development.
Help define and refine working processes in order to maximize efficiency in constantly evolving environments.
Mentor and manage team members.
Participate in a culture of learning and growing.
What we’d like to see.

Join us in building the future of finance.
Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.
TradePMR is Robinhood's custody and technology platform for registered investment advisors.

We're in the middle of one of the most ambitious builds in Robinhood's history: building a next-generation custody platform that lets advisors work seamlessly across custodians, with AI-native insights, digital onboarding, and access to cutting-edge, first-of-a-kind asset classes — delivered as cohesive platform.

A core part of this vision is bringing the same intuitive, retail-grade tools and experiences Robinhood has built for individual investors to financial advisors and the clients they serve.
The advisors we serve are growth-oriented, multicustodial RIAs, and they run their practices on a stack of portfolio management, CRM, financial planning, and increasingly AI-native tools. Our job is to make TradePMR the easiest, most modern custodian in that stack to build and work with — foundational APIs today, and an increasingly partner-first platform as the industry moves toward agentic, AI-driven advisor workflows tomorrow.
This role sits at the center of that effort: part outward-facing partner/advisor advocate, part technical product owner for our integration platform.
This role is based in our Clearwater, Fl, Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.
At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

Own our third-party integration strategy end-to-end — from prioritizing and scoping which APIs and connectivity we build (including emerging AI-agent standards like MCP) to defining the sandbox, documentation, authentication, and governance that make us easy to integrate with.
Be the primary, outward-facing product owner for our technology-partner ecosystem — leading commercial and technical conversations with PMS/CRM vendors and AI-native advisor tools, scoping statements of work, setting production-access requirements, and representing Robinhood at industry events and with key RIA-industry influencers.
Build and run the framework for how we tier, prioritize, and resource integration requests across dozens of vendors and advisor firms at once — balancing large-firm strategic bets against overall platform coherence and engineering capacity.
Partner closely with engineering to translate advisor and partner needs into technical requirements and make the build-vs-partner-vs-defer calls — comfortable reading an API spec or discussing an SSO/OAuth flow directly with a partner's engineering team.
Develop a clear point of view on how AI and agentic workflows are changing custodial integrations
Represent the integrations function in Robinhood's broader next-generation custody roadmap, working closely with cross-functional partners across product, engineering, and operations to keep near-term integration work aligned with our long-term vision for advisor-facing custody.

6+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion spent in a technical, platform, or API/integrations-focused PM role.
Experience working at a high-growth fintech company, with a track record of navigating the regulatory, compliance, and legacy-system realities that shape technical integration work in financial services.
A strong, informed point of view on how AI is reshaping fintech and advisor workflows — ideally backed by direct experience shipping AI-enabled features or evaluating AI-native vendors and partners.
Genuinely technical and a proven builder — comfortable as the primary point of contact with external partner engineering teams, able to reason through API design, auth (SSO/SAML/OAuth), and data models, with a track record of shipping developer-facing platform capabilities (documentation, sandboxes, versioning) in a regulated or enterprise B2B environment.
Experience running a partner or vendor ecosystem: prioritization frameworks, SOWs/contracts, production-access gating, and managing a portfolio of integrations at very different maturity stages at the same time.
Excellent written and verbal communication — you can flex between a technical design conversation with engineering and a strategic partnership conversation with an executive or advisor.
Comfortable with ambiguity: this role is being created by combining two existing scopes into one, and part of the job is defining what "great" looks like as you go.

Experience in wealth management, RIA custody, or advisor technology, or working with custodial/clearing operations (e.g., First Clearing, Schwab, Fidelity).
Experience building or scaling a formal integration/partner program (tiering, vendor onboarding, developer portal) from a relatively early stage.

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health.

You will own the data platform and the self-service experience that domain technical data teams operate within. Your stakeholder is the engineer, the analyst, the domain data team building and maintaining data products across Toast’s ecosystem.

Design and evolve the self-service experience: discovery, onboarding, certification workflows, and documentation.
Run discovery with domain technical data teams — understand their needs, pain points, and maturity — and translate into platform requirements.
Design the paved paths, templates, and tooling domain teams follow to build and maintain data products — ensuring governance standards are enforceable through platform capabilities.
Drive platform adoption. Measure whether teams are using what you shipped and iterate until they are.
Partner hand-in-hand with Data Engineering & Platform — they build and operate the platform; you define what it needs to become and why — balancing new capability against reliability and operational excellence.
Ensure domain maturity progression is unblocked by tooling — teams ready to advance have what they need.
Maintain interoperability — data products built by any domain are discoverable, governed, and consumable by others (humans and AI agents).

Track record shipping platform capabilities that enable self-service at scale

At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible.

We are hiring the next generation of product managers. AI has collapsed the work that used to sit between an idea and a working version of it, and for the first time, PMs can be true builders. The PMs who win in this era do not manage the work. They build the product, every day, with their own hands.
A Senior Product Manager owns a meaningful surface of ClickUp and is accountable for whether it gets better. You decide what to build and why, then go build a working version of it. You prototype in Cursor and Claude when an idea is faster shown than written.

You live in the data and the customer signal, and the time between spotting a problem and having something people can react to is measured in days, not weeks. The PMs who compound the most impact at this level are the ones who keep finding leverage that did not exist last quarter.

Own the vision, roadmap, and delivery for a defined product surface, balancing near-term wins with longer-horizon investments.
Run continuous discovery. Building and using agents to monitor and synthesize that part of your job.
Write sharp PRDs and specs that give engineering and design what they need to move fast without ambiguity.
Define success metrics before you build, track them after you ship, and iterate when outcomes do not match expectations.
Prototype your own ideas using Cursor, Claude Code, and our Prototype Playground. Show the concept before filing the ticket.
Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, analytics, and GTM without needing to be managed through the process.
Present your roadmap and results clearly to stakeholders and leadership, and update them when direction changes.
Spot friction in how the team operates and suggest concrete improvements.

5 or more years in product management with demonstrated end-to-end ownership of a product area in a B2B SaaS environment.
Proven track record of shipping. You have taken features from concept through launch and iterated based on data.
Strong prioritization instincts. You know how to say no and can defend it.
High customer empathy and the ability to separate what users say from what they actually need.
Comfortable with data. You define your own metrics, query dashboards, and make arguments from numbers.
Clear written and verbal communicator. Your specs and strategy docs create alignment without requiring a follow-up meeting.
Comfortable with ambiguity and a fast pace. You do not wait to be told what to do.
Hands-on with AI tools. You already use them and are always looking for new ways to get more out of them.

Generate artifacts that accelerate alignment. Leverage AI to draft PRDs, map user flows, validate product launch readiness, synthesize research and customer feedback, produce competitive analyses, and write release notes.
Prototype and iterate with AI coding tools. Build functional prototypes independently of design and engineering using tools like Cursor or Claude Code.
QA your own work. Use browser automation tools to test flows, verify edge cases, and confirm what shipped matches what was specced.
Stay current and apply it. Familiarity with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Figma AI, and MCP integrations is expected. Actively experiment and fold new capabilities into your workflow.
